parttimedigitalmarketingcommunicationsco.title: Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator
parttimedigitalmarketingcommunicationsco.description:
Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator
  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona (UCPSA) Tucson, Arizona
 
 
  Part-Time | 20–25 Hours Per Week | Flexible Schedule l Pay Commensurate With Experience 
  

 
 
  

  
Help Us Grow a Brand That Reflects Our Mission
  

  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona (UCPSA) is seeking a creative, resourceful, and digitally savvy Part-Time Digital Marketing & Communications Coordinator to help strengthen our brand, expand our digital presence, and share the stories of the people and communities we serve. UCPSA provides home and community-based services for children and adults with disabilities and older adults throughout Southern Arizona. Our mission is meaningful, our culture is collaborative, and our work changes lives every day. 
  

  

   We are looking for someone who can translate that impact into compelling digital content. This role is ideal for a communications or marketing professional who enjoys variety, works well independently, brings fresh ideas to the table, and is looking for meaningful work with a flexible part-time schedule. 
  

  
What You'll Do
  

   In this role, you'll help shape how UCPSA shows up online and in the community. 
  

   Responsibilities include: 
  

  
   Help develop and strengthen UCPSA's digital brand and online presence
   Manage and update website content to ensure information is current, engaging, and easy to navigate
   Create, schedule, and manage content across UCPSA's social media platforms
   Develop email newsletters, internal communications, announcements, and promotional materials
   Write and edit stories that highlight UCPSA's employees, programs, families, community partnerships, events, and impact
   Support digital marketing campaigns designed to increase awareness, engagement, recruitment, and community visibility
   Maintain a consistent brand voice and visual identity across communication channels
   Create or coordinate photography and visual content for digital and print use
   Assist with event promotion and community outreach communications
   Review website, email, and social media performance data and identify opportunities to improve engagement
   Collaborate with leadership and staff to identify stories, communication needs, and marketing opportunities
   Stay current on emerging digital marketing practices, communication trends, and technology
  
  
What You Bring
  

   Minimum Qualifications 
  

  
   High school diploma or equivalent
   At least two years of professional experience in marketing, communications, public relations, digital media, advertising, social media, or a closely related field
   Experience creating content for social media, websites, newsletters, or other digital platforms
   Experience working within a website content management system
   Strong writing, editing, proofreading, and verbal communication skills
   Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and the ability to quickly learn new technology and software
   Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines
   Ability to work independently, use sound judgment, and follow projects through to completion
   A combination of relevant education, training, and professional experience may be considered when it demonstrates the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully perform the responsibilities of the position
   Valid Arizona Driver's License and an acceptable driving record when driving is required for position responsibilities
   Ability to obtain a Level 1 Arizona Fingerprint Clearance Card and pass comprehensive background checks (ex. Adult Protective Services, Department of Child Safety etc.)
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  

   We'd be especially interested in candidates who bring one or more of the following: 
  

  
   Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Digital Media, Graphic Design, or a related discipline
   Experience working for a nonprofit, human services, healthcare, disability services, or other mission-focused organization
   Photography and/or video production experience
   Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar graphic design tools
   Experience creating and managing email marketing campaigns and newsletters
   Familiarity with Google Analytics, social media insights, or other digital performance tools
   Understanding of SEO, content strategy, digital branding, and audience engagement
   Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns across several communication channels
   Bilingual fluency in English and Spanish
  
  
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
  

   The person who will thrive in this position will be able to: 
  

  
   Create clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate content across multiple digital platforms
   Understand how social media, website content, email marketing, storytelling, and visual design work together to support a brand
   Maintain website content using common content management systems
   Develop content that supports organizational goals while remaining authentic and mission-focused
   Turn ideas, programs, and everyday moments into compelling stories
   Write professionally with strong attention to grammar, tone, accuracy, and consistency
   Use analytics and audience feedback to improve digital content and communication strategies
   Manage projects independently without requiring extensive day-to-day direction
   Take initiative, identify opportunities, and bring forward new ideas
   Learn new platforms, tools, and digital practices as technology evolves
   Collaborate effectively with employees, leadership, community partners, and outside vendors
   Communicate respectfully and effectively with people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences
  
  
Physical Requirements
  

   This position is generally classified as light work. 
  

  

   Employees may occasionally need to move or carry items weighing up to approximately 20 pounds and frequently handle lighter materials or equipment.
 
 
 
  The role also involves regular computer use and may include periods of sitting, standing, walking, taking photographs, attending meetings, and participating in UCPSA or community events. 
  

  
Why Join UCPSA?
  

   At UCPSA, your work will help tell the stories of people with disabilities, older adults, families, employees, and programs that make a real difference in Southern Arizona.
 
 
  
We offer:
  

  
   20–25 hours per week
   A flexible work schedule
  
 
 
  Eligible for PTO and dental insurance
  A supportive and collaborative workplace
  Meaningful work connected to an important mission
  The opportunity to help shape and grow UCPSA's digital brand
  Room to bring your ideas, creativity, and personality to the role
 
 
  
Ready to Tell Stories That Matter?
  

   Please submit your résumé along with examples of your work. Samples may include social media content, newsletters, writing, website content, marketing campaigns, photography, graphic design, or other communications projects. 
  

  

   If you're creative, curious, dependable, and excited about using digital marketing to help a mission-driven organization grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 
 

 
  

  

   At United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona, we value a diverse, inclusive workforce and we provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. All qualified applicants for employment will be considered without regard to an individuals race, color, sex, gender identity, gender expression, religion, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws. If you are unable to submit your application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at rmurray@ucpsa.org 
  

  

   United Cerebral Palsy of Southern Arizona will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities to the extent required by applicable law.

strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.title: Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners
strategicpartnershipsmanagerdigitalmarke.description:
Overview
 
  As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit's commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.
 
 


 
  

   ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms — they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.
 
 


 
  

   Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work — and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.
 
 
 
  

   Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue — you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.
 
 


 
  

   PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner — defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments.
 
 

    Responsibilities


 
  ERP analyst relationships
 
 
  Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit's mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.
  Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending — keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.
  Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.
  Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit's mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.
  Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.
 
 


 
  

   Digital marketing agency relationships
 
 
  Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs — prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.
  Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.
  Enable agency partners on Intuit's mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria — ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.
  Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.
  Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.
 
 


 
  

   Portfolio management & reporting
 
 
  Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.
  Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans — additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.
  Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.
  Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations — buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends — to the IES product and go-to-market teams.
 
 


 
  

   Cross-functional collaboration
 
 
  Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.
  Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit's position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.
  Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit's product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations.
 
 

    Qualifications


 
  Required
 
 
  10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.
  Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community — you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.
  Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.
  Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.
  Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.
  Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms.
 
 


 
  

   Preferred
 
 
  Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators — you have existing relationships in this community.
  Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.
  Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).
 
 

   Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

 The expected base pay range for this position is: 
 

  Albany $189,500 - $256,000 
 

  California Remote (Bay Area) $186,500- $252,500 
 

  California Remote (Not Bay Area) $179,000- $242,500

marketingbusinessdevelopmentcoordinatoru.title: Marketing & Business Development Coordinator
marketingbusinessdevelopmentcoordinatoru.description:
Unió Digital has grown almost entirely on word of mouth. This role is how we widen that. The Marketing & Business Development Coordinator owns top-of-funnel engagement: the vendor-funded programs, the hosted events, the social presence, and the content that puts us in front of Arizona businesses before they have a problem to solve.

This is a new role, both for Unió Digital and for the Sales & Marketing team. We are a small company in a growth phase, so expect to wear several hats and expect the shape of the job to move as we learn what works. Whoever takes this seat helps define what it becomes rather than inheriting a finished playbook.

In a given month you might build a co-marketing campaign against a vendor's marketing development fund budget, host a lunch-and-learn for a dozen operations managers, run a webinar with one of our security partners, publish a blog post and tune the page it lives on, and keep LinkedIn moving in between. You will be out of the office and in front of people regularly, including some evenings.

We do not hard sell. Clients call us back because we find the thing that is actually broken and fix it. Every conversation you start should follow that pattern: understand the problem first, then talk about whether we are the right answer.

Responsibilities:

Generate awareness and inbound conversations beyond referrals, and grow the top of the funnel in the Tucson and southern Arizona marketOwn vendor marketing development fund (MDF) programs: propose co-marketing plans, submit for approval, execute them, and report results back to the vendorHost and run events end to end, from invite list through follow-up: lunch-and-learns, client dinners, vendor showcases, and webinarsRun the social channels with a consistent voice and a real cadence (LinkedIn first, then Instagram and Facebook)Write and publish blog content, and make the minor website and on-page SEO updates that keep it findableRepresent Unió Digital at chambers, associations, trade shows, and community eventsOpen consultative conversations with prospects and referral sources, then hand qualified opportunities to the account teamTrack what works: event attendance, content performance, channel growth, and the conversations each one producesQualifications:

2+ years in B2B marketing, events, partner marketing, or a comparable outward-facing role; vendor or channel marketing exposure (MDF, co-op funds, partner programs) is a plus, not a requirementComfortable hosting a room: able to run a lunch-and-learn or a webinar without a script and keep it usefulWorking knowledge of SEO and web content, enough to publish a post and fix the page it sits on (WordPress, HubSpot, or comparable)Strong written voice; able to draft copy and turn a technician's explanation into something a business owner will actually readA consultative instinct: you ask what is broken before you talk about what we sellComfortable building something that does not exist yet: this is a new seat, and the priorities will move as we find out what worksEligible to work in the U.S.; based in or relocating to Tucson, AZ; available for occasional evening and early-morning events

executiveeventscommunicationssupervisors.description:
This position offers a base salary range of $71,651 - $119,419 per year, depending on experience and qualifications, plus bonus based on company performance.

One of the MANY work perkz at Sheetz is quarterly employee bonuses based on company performance! And there’s more – A LOT more… like competitive salaries, PTO and parental leave, 401k match and employee stock ownership, limitless professional development and growth opportunities, tuition reimbursement, full medical, vision and dental coverage, and snack discounts!

 
OVERVIEW

Responsible for executing Executive and Events communication plans, providing supervision for a team of professionals, overseeing the development, coordination, and delivery of executive messaging, communications, and event-related content that supports business objectives and company events. Partners with executives, department leaders, and key stakeholders to align communication priorities, develop effective messaging strategies, and ensure successful execution of communication and event objectives.

 
RESPONSIBILITIES (other duties may be assigned)

1. Supervise a team of professionals in the execution of communication strategies, projects, and initiatives that support organizational goals and business priorities.
2. Develop and implement executive communication plans that effectively communicate leadership priorities, business objectives, organizational updates, and key initiatives to targeted audiences.
3. Oversee the creation, editing, approval, and distribution of executive communications across appropriate channels to ensure consistency, accuracy, and alignment with organizational messaging.
4. Partner with executives, department leaders, and key stakeholders to identify communication needs, establish priorities, and develop strategic messaging approaches.
5. Manage the review, prioritization, and consolidation of communication requests to ensure messaging is timely, relevant, effective, and coordinated across the organization.
6. Lead communication planning and support for corporate events, ensuring messaging strategies, materials, and communications align with event objectives and business needs.
7. Coordinate with event support teams and cross-functional partners to facilitate communication activities before, during, and after organizational events and initiatives.
8. Ensure event-related content and key messages are communicated to both event participants and broader organizational audiences, as appropriate, to maximize awareness and engagement.
9. Monitor communication effectiveness and recommend improvements to communication processes, messaging strategies, channels, and audience engagement practices.
10. Manage, develop, coach, and evaluate direct reports, fostering accountability, collaboration, professional development, and achievement of individual and departmental objectives.

 
QUALIFICATIONS

(Equivalent combinations of education, licenses, certifications and/or experience may be considered)


Education
• Bachelor’s Degree in Communications, Journalism or related field required

Experience
• Minimum 5 years’ experience in communication responsibilities or related field with at least one year of writing / editing experience required.
• Retail operations experience required.
• Previous supervisory experience preferred.

Licenses/Certifications
• None required

Tools & Equipment 
• General Office Equipment

 
ACCOMMODATIONS

Sheetz is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. Sheetz is committed to considering all applicants regardless of disability who can perform all essential job duties with or without accommodations.

partnershipsocialmediaspecialistvisitmes.title: Partnership & Social Media Specialist
partnershipsocialmediaspecialistvisitmes.description:
Position Summary: The Partnership & Social Media Specialist supports Visit Mesa’s Partnership Program and consumer marketing efforts by coordinating partner engagement, fulfilling partnership benefits, and creating and supporting social media content. This partner-facing role helps ensure a consistent, high-quality partner experience through timely communication, organized execution of contracted deliverables, and in-market content capture. 
 

   Working closely with the Director, Destination Experience and Content Marketing Manager, the Specialist serves as a key connector between Visit Mesa partners and internal teams while contributing to Visit Mesa’s content pipeline and destination storytelling.


  ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES


  Partnership Engagement & Supports


 
  
   Conduct regular in-market visits with partners based on partnership team priorities.
   Serve as a day-to-day contact for assigned partner questions, requests, and follow-up, escalating strategic, sensitive, or revenue-related matters to the Director, Destination Experience as appropriate.
   Share relevant Visit Mesa updates, gather partner feedback, and identify opportunities, needs, and potential concerns.
   Manage assigned partner renewals, including outreach, follow-up, presentation of partnership performance, and identification of appropriate upsell opportunities that increase partner value and revenue.
   Maintain accurate records of partner interactions, requests, and follow-up items in the CRM.
   Support partner onboarding, orientations, and training, conducted in person or virtually, by preparing materials, coordinating logistics, and following up on next steps.
   Help strengthen partner satisfaction and retention through consistent communication and responsive support.
  
 
  Partnership Deliverables & Fulfillment


 
  
   Coordinate and track contracted partnership benefits and deliverables to help ensure accurate, timely fulfillment.
   Maintain deliverable timelines, status updates, and supporting documentation.
   Coordinate with internal teams, including marketing, sales, creative, and communications, to facilitate partner benefits and confirm expectations.
   Serve as a liaison between assigned partners and internal teams regarding deliverable details, deadlines, and required materials.
   Assist with preparing partner updates and supporting materials that communicate the value and results of Visit Mesa partnership benefits.
   Identify potential fulfillment gaps or delays and communicate them promptly to the Director, Destination Experience.
  
 
  Content Capture & Social Media Support


 
  
   Capture photo and video content during partner visits, events, and destination experiences for use across Visit Mesa marketing channels.
   Assist with the development of partner-focused content that highlights Mesa businesses, experiences, events, and destination offerings.
   Support social media execution by drafting and scheduling posts, monitoring comments and messages, and engaging with audiences in alignment with Visit Mesa’s voice and established guidelines.
   Coordinate with the Content Marketing Manager to ensure partner-related content aligns with the content calendar, campaign priorities, and brand standards.
   Organize and maintain content assets, permissions, and relevant partner information for efficient future use.
   Stay current on social media trends, emerging platforms, and community engagement opportunities, sharing relevant ideas with the marketing team.
  
 
  Community Outreach & Cross-Functional Support


 
  
   Represent Visit Mesa professionally at partner meetings, partnership events, community events, and relevant industry functions.
   Support partnership events, outreach activities, and initiatives that promote partner engagement and revenue growth.
   Assist with special projects and other department needs as assigned.
   Help maintain the visitor center and answer incoming phone calls as needed.
  
 
  Qualifications


 
  
   Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, Tourism, Business, or a related field preferred; equivalent education and experience may be considered.
   Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in content marketing, digital communications, or a related field.
   Hospitality, tourism, association, or economic development experience preferred.
   Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills with the ability to adapt content for diverse audiences.
   Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently while collaborating effectively in a team environment.
   Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams, SharePoint, and PowerPoint) required; experience with Adobe Creative Suite and email marketing platforms preferred.

We prioritize the #HumanFirst approach and strive to enable prosthetic wearers to live the life they love.





Job Overview


The Marketing Coordinator supports the execution of marketing programs, events, communications, digital initiatives, and other projects that help drive brand awareness and business growth. This role works closely with members of the Marketing, Sales, and Clinical Education teams to coordinate projects, maintain marketing materials, support events, and assist with day-to-day marketing activities.


This role also provides support to Proteor's Global Marketing team, helping coordinate cross-regional campaigns, content, and brand initiatives to ensure consistency and alignment across global markets.





Requirements


Key Responsibilities and Duties



Coordinate marketing campaigns and initiatives across digital, social media, email, events, public relations, and other channels.
Support trade show and event planning, including registration, exhibit logistics, promotional materials, travel coordination, shipping, and internal communications.
Assist with the coordination of sponsorship and community programs, including events and related marketing activities.
Support website projects, including content organization, updates, maintenance, and coordination with internal and external partners.
Assist with social media activities, including content coordination, scheduling, monitoring, and engagement.
Coordinate the inventory and distribution of marketing collateral, promotional items, product samples, and event materials.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

1–3 years of professional experience required.
Internship, co-op, or other relevant hands-on marketing experience may be considered as part of overall experience.
Experience coordinating projects, events, social media, digital marketing, or marketing communications is preferred.

marketingcommunicationsdirectoramericanh.description:
Overview



Since our founding in 1924, we've cut cardiovascular disease deaths in half, but there is still so much more to do. To overcome today’s biggest health challenges and accelerate this progress, we need passionate individuals like you. Join our movement, be part of the progress, and help ensure a healthier future for all. You matter, and so does the impact you can make with us.



The American Heart Association has an exciting opportunity for a  Marketing Communications Director  serving the Nevada and Southern Arizona Division teams.



This hybrid role may be based in Las Vegas, NV, or Tucson, AZ, with work taking place across home office, community, and office settings to support marketing, communications, and mission-driven initiatives.



The Marketing Communications Director develops and implements strategic communications, marketing, media relations, and public relations initiatives for the American Heart Association across the Nevada and Southern, while providing communications support for other territories as needed. This role advances the American Heart Association’s position as the leading authority on cardiovascular health and science through integrated external and internal communications, marketing campaigns, media outreach, digital strategies, sponsorship activation, and special initiatives.



The Association offers many resources to help you maintain work-life harmonization through your changing needs and life situations. To help you be successful, you will have access to Heart U, our award-winning corporate university, as well as additional training and support, locally.



#TheAHALife is more than a company culture; it is our way of life. It embodies our commitment to work-life harmonization and is guided by our core values where our employees can thrive both personally and professionally. Discover why you will Be Seen. Be Heard. Be Valued at the American Heart Association by following us on LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, and at heart.jobs.



Responsibilities



Brand   Integrity




Maintains the integrity of the brand and identity of the American Heart Association by developing and/or reviewing/editing communications and marketing materials.


Traditional and Digital Media




Raise visibility of the Division via traditional and digital media outlets. Maintain and steward existing media relationships. Explore and engage new outlets, especially media with reach to targeted audiences. Research and monitor new/burgeoning media, especially those being developed in the Las Vegas and Tucson markets.


Seeks, cultivates, and maintains regional media relationships, with traditional and emerging media.


Secures formal media partnerships/sponsorships for various events, campaigns and cause initiatives as appropriate.


Pitches “big picture” stories, focusing on hard news, feature and research stories, to Las Vegas and Tucson markets.


Researches and prepares media and background materials to support American Heart Association policy issues and community programs.


Develops fast response mechanism for hard news stories. Alerts field staff with media advisories and cause/marketing activities as appropriate.




Overall Campaign Development and Traction




Work closely with internal partners to be an innovator and market disruptor. Seek new approaches to transforming sponsorship communications and marketing deliverables. Steward current sponsorships and expand into new industries. Help craft mission-focused proposals and weave in media, marketing and messaging themes to fully complement our campaigns. Contribute to campaign revenue through health asset sponsorships/activations.


Develops and submits proposals outlining the details of the partnerships/sponsorships.


Supports day-of event activities.




Elevate Visibility of Local Divisions as Engaged Community Stakeholders




To truly make an impact, each market needs to be widely recognized as a trusted and reliable stakeholder. We are invested in the overall health of the communities we serve.


Implements communications plans with media advocacy, public policy initiatives and media spokespeople. Contributes to volunteer leadership, including helping identify and recruit potential committee and board members.


Identifies, recruits and trains volunteers who can serve as media and cause initiative spokespersons. Maintains an accessible database of human interest stories to tap for media inquiries.


Develops and executes social media strategy in conjunction with digital staff.


Works with internal and external partners to produce mission-focused content for organic social channels.


Plans and executes paid social media campaigns.


Develops, in conjunction with field staff and volunteers, and oversees implementation of communications and marketing plans.


Works with internal partners to ensure effective local implementation of field-related communications and marketing activities.


Works with external media partners to plan and execute advertising campaigns.


Serves as communications and marketing consultant to staff and volunteers, including conducting communications orientation and training, monitoring progress on key objectives and cause initiatives, and providing general counsel and guidance.


Coordinates, in conjunction with National Center and Western States communications and marketing staff, communications- and marketing-related promotions, mailings, distribution, and reporting.




Qualifications




3 years minimum prior related experience with:


Knowledge of variety of mass and alternative media, and principles of journalism including news gathering, interviewing, writing and editing. Basic video, graphic design and photography skills desired.


Experience in communications, marketing, or public affairs with a background in journalism, public relations, marketing, advertising or similar position.


Knowledge and experience with the fundamentals of multiple disciplines are needed, including the principles and ethics of public relations, promotion, marketing and business communications.


Demonstrated excellence in written communications skills, including news, business, and persuasive writing.


Demonstrated skills in effective one-on-one and group communications and work with all levels of media contacts, community leaders, and American Heart Association volunteers and staff.


Ability to deal professionally in a corporate and non-profit environment and assume responsibility for guiding communications and marketing projects and programs from inception through completion.


Demonstrated ability to simultaneously manage multiple, complex projects in varying stages of development under time pressure.


Knowledge and experience with developing content for event collateral materials.


University/College degree or equivalent experience.




Here are some of the preferred skills we are looking for:




Knowledge of the principles and practices of strategic planning, budgeting, and managing work.


Knowledge of basic fund-raising principles, practices, and techniques.


Knowledge of American Heart Association’s mission and programs.




Compensation & Benefits



Expected pay range will be $64,575 to $86,205 annually. Pay is commensurate with experience; geographic differentials to the pay range may apply. The American Heart Association reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range.



The American Heart Association invests in its people. Here are the main components of our total rewards package.  Visit Rewards & Benefits to see more details.




Compensation  – Our goal is to ensure you have a competitive base salary.  That’s why we regularly review the market value of jobs and make adjustments, as needed.


Performance and Recognition  – You are rewarded for achieving success through annual salary planning and incentive programs; eligibility for an incentive program is based on the type of position.


Benefits  – We offer a wide array of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance, along with a robust retirement program that includes an employer match and automatic contribution.  As a mark of our commitment to employee well-being, we also offer an employee assistance program, employee wellness program and telemedicine, and medical consultation.


Professional Development –  You can join one of our many Employee Resource Groups (ERG) or be a mentor/mentee in our professional mentoring program.  Heart U is the Association’s national online university, with more than 100,000 resources designed to meet your needs and busy schedule.


Work-Life Harmonization –  The Association offers Paid Time Off (PTO) at a minimum of 16 days per year for new employees.  The number of days will increase based on seniority level.  You will also have a total of 12 paid holidays off each year, which includes several days off at the end of the year.


Tuition Assistance  - We support the career development of all employees.  This program provides financial assistance to employees who wish to further their education and career in relation to their current duties and responsibilities, or for potential future positions in the organization.




The American Heart Association’s 2028 Goal: Building on over 100 years of trusted leadership in cardiovascular and brain health, by 2028 the Association will drive breakthroughs and implement proven solutions in science, policy, and care for healthier people and communities. The greatest discoveries in health must reach everyone where they are.



At American Heart Association | American Stroke Association, our mission is to be a relentless force for a world of longer, healthier lives, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, religion, age, language, sexual orientation, national origin and physical or cognitive abilities.

PRO EM National Event Services is a national leader in large-scale event production, providing tents, staging, flooring, and turn-key event solutions for sporting events, concerts and festivals, corporate events, weddings, construction and government clients across the country. As PRO EM continues to grow, the Marketing Specialist will own day-to-day execution of the company's marketing efforts and serve as the primary point of contact for PRO EM's outside marketing strategist and content partners, translating their strategic direction into content, campaigns, and sales enablement materials. This is a hands-on execution role, not a strategy-setting role, reporting to PRO EM's marketing leadership.

Responsibilities

•       Reports to PRO EM's marketing leadership

•       Own day-to-day execution of PRO EM's marketing plan and content calendar, translating direction from leadership and PRO EM's outside marketing strategist/consultant into action

•       Serve as the primary point of contact for PRO EM's outside content, social media, and creative partners, briefing priorities and reviewing deliverables for brand and quality before they go out

•       Lead creation and scheduling of content across social media, the website, email marketing, and paid social channels

•       Develop and manage marketing and sales enablement materials (proposals, brochures, spec sheets, case studies, presentations) in partnership with the sales team

•       Manage on-site photo and video content capture at client events, building a consistent library across sports, concerts, festivals, corporate, and social events

•       Own website content updates and basic SEO hygiene within PRO EM's existing content management system

•       Coordinate PRO EM's presence at industry trade shows, conferences, and networking events

•       Track and report on marketing performance metrics (web traffic, lead generation, social engagement, campaign ROI), and flag trends or recommendations to leadership

•       Help maintain brand consistency across every region, business line, and outside partner's work

•       Support public relations efforts, including drafting press release copy, fielding routine media inquiries, and compiling award submissions

•       Perform other duties as assigned

Requirements

•       Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience

•       4-6 years of progressive marketing experience, including content creation, social media, and campaign execution

•       Demonstrated experience coordinating or managing outside agencies, freelancers, or vendors

•       Comfortable working within a website content management system; familiarity with graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar) a plus

•       Solid working knowledge of digital marketing channels (SEO/SEM, paid social, email marketing) and analytics tools such as Google Analytics

•       Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to represent the PRO EM brand to clients, partners, and the public

•       Strong project management skills, able to manage multiple campaigns, deadlines, and regional priorities at once

•       Comfortable taking strategic direction from outside partners and translating it into content and campaigns with minimal oversight

•       Experience in events, live entertainment, hospitality, or a related industry preferred

We are seeking a highly motivated, seasoned Partner Marketing Manager to join the Consumer Marketing team and help deliver on its mission for the 1 billion professionals on the platform.
As the Partner Marketing Manager for Consumer Marketing, you will be responsible for shaping partner marketing strategy, expanding partner engagement, and driving adoption for partner integration features across various parts of the LinkedIn app. You will focus on both existing partners and growing new partners, while bringing new program ideas to life.

Reporting to the Director of Product Marketing, this role will focus on executing multi-channel campaigns and events in collaboration with strategic partners and internal teams across business development, marketing, communications, product, legal, engineering, and design.

Our team’s culture mirrors a startup within a large company. Team members are entrepreneurial leaders who are willing to be scrappy and learn and iterate quickly. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, results-oriented professional with strong project management capabilities and a mindset for creative innovation. They thrive in cross-functional environments, bring fresh thinking to complex challenges, and maintain a clear focus on turning ideas into meaningful outcomes.

Responsibilities
Build and own partner marketing strategies from the ground up, turning new product features, integrations, and partnerships into high-impact go-to-market opportunities.
Work directly with internal and external partners to develop creative campaigns, from co-branded content and social activations to demand generation programs, that drive awareness, engagement, and pipeline growth.
Turn partner wins into compelling stories, case studies, and thought leadership that demonstrate product value, build credibility, and create demand.
Be the voice of our partners internally, collaborating across Marketing, Communications, Product, Sales, and Business Development to move quickly, align priorities, and bring programs to market.

Define success metrics, track campaign and pipeline performance, surface actionable insights, and continuously experiment to improve what works.
Manage budgets and resources with a startup mindset, prioritizing the highest-impact opportunities, making thoughtful tradeoffs, and maximizing return on every investment.

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, technology, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in partner marketing, partnerships, or a related role within the advertising, media, or technology industries.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience working directly with partners, creative agencies, and vendors, with a strong understanding of partner marketing, pipeline generation, and go-to-market execution.
Strong ability to influence, align, and build relationships across a wide range of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment where priorities can shift quickly.
Experience creating partner-facing case studies, microsites, decks, enablement materials, or other collateral using Figma, Canva, Adobe, or similar tools.
Creative and strategic thinker with strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

Strong sense of ownership and accountability with a proactive, self-starting approach.
Resourceful and scrappy, with the ability to find creative solutions and make thoughtful tradeoffs.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Marketing Advisor is responsible for business marketing advisory and consulting of 12-15 Cardone Ventures’ clients and the regular review and monitoring of their sales & marketing activities and data. As “fractional CMO/CRO” for the client, they will prepare metrics reports, generate marketing budgets and campaign plans, and leverage their sales and marketing experience to guide client revenue maximization through each step of their unique customer engagement models.  Our mission is to help business owners achieve their personal, professional, and financial goals through the growth of their businesses. We work in dozens of verticals and provide strategic business guidance through courses, live events, partnerships, and investments. Our core values are the backbone of our business and guide our hiring process: we are inspirational, disciplined, accountable, transparent, aligned, and results oriented. This company operates nationally and is growing by the day.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

directorsocialandcommunicationskeurigdrp.title: Director, Social and Communications
directorsocialandcommunicationskeurigdrp.description:
Job Overview:
Director, Social & Communications 

This role is specific to the current Coffee Operating Unit of KDP.  Following the recent, successful acquisition of JDE Peet’s in April 2026, the Coffee Operating Unit will become its own independent publicly traded company.  For more information on this, please visit keurigdrpepper.com  

 The Director, Social & Communications will be responsible for driving consumer share of mind and elevating the love of the Coffee Operating Unit’s North American brands through a cohesive, insights-driven strategy that unifies organic social execution, culture/influencer marketing, public relations and social intelligence. 

 An effective, integrated social function will bring together social (content, community management, creator/talent) and communications (brand public relations) to drive earned and social conversation and build brand love among fans and consumers. This role also includes the use of social intelligence to identify content opportunity areas, nurturing existing fans and recruiting new fans. 

 

As a senior leader, you will oversee long-term planning, team leadership, agency management, and cross-functional collaboration across Brand Marketing, Communications, Media, Insights, Legal, and external partners. The ideal candidate brings 10+ years of experience leading social, communications, and consumer engagement programs for large consumer brands and has a proven track record of building teams and delivering business results 

Key Responsibilities  

Develop and execute the Coffee Operating Unit North America organic social, creator, entertainment/talent, brand PR, and social intelligence strategies and governance  

Ensure alignment between social, PR, media, partnerships, and marketing initiatives Partner with Media leadership to develop holistic strategies and recommend spend allocations into content, community engagement, creator and comms/PR  channels while connecting social strategy to applicable aspects of the business, ensuring consistency in mechanisms of communication across brands and with corporate communications Develop and maintain all governance and process mechanisms so that there are consistent ways of working and aligned processes across all North American brands and teams  Determine the internal vs external team and agencies, creators and partners structures and ways of working  Select, own relationships and maintain scopes and management with external agencies, creators and partners   

Lead the development of annual, multi-year, and campaign-specific plans for social media, creator marketing, community engagement, and brand communications  

Social Content Strategy 

Oversee the development & ongoing management of the annual content calendar at the portfolio level, ensuring alignment with key brand initiatives, product launches, and seasonal campaigns Establish content frameworks, editorial priorities, and channel strategies. Lead the creation of engaging, strategic, and data-driven content across social media platforms  Create efficient content creation processes and work with agency partners to optimize content engine Use audience insights, social listening, and performance data to guide content decisions. Evaluate content performance and recommend ongoing improvements.  

Community Management & Engagement 

Lead proactive and reactive community management and engagement strategies across social channels Establish processes for moderation, escalation management, and consumer response. Partner with social listening and insights teams to identify trends, consumer feedback, and potential risks. Work strategically and collaboratively with cross-functional teams across paid media and other parts of the organization as well as agency partners to optimize content for search engines (paid search, social search, agentic search) Oversee engagement plans for campaigns, launches, partnerships, and key brand moments. Monitor sentiment and community performance to inform brand and communications strategies  

Creator & Influencer Strategy 

Lead creator and influencer strategy across priority brands. Develop annual creator plans that support business and marketing objectives. Oversee creator selection, negotiations, contracting, and performance measurement. Manage relationships with creators, agencies, and talent partners. Integrate creator programs into broader marketing and communications initiatives. Evaluate program effectiveness through engagement, brand, and business performance metrics.  

Communications/Brand PR 

Oversee portfolio-level influencer and PR strategy that amplifies company and brand growth, builds lasting partnerships, and delivers measurable outcomes Monitor and analyze cultural and entertainment trends, in coordination with social intelligence, to inform marketing strategies and identify opportunities for brand engagement and partnerships Identify and cultivate relationships with key media partners, creators, influencers, artists, cultural icons, and entertainment partners, including film studios, television networks, musicians, gaming, and streaming platforms Manage the end-to-end operations of influencer/content creators/talent and integration into marketing campaigns, ensuring brand consistency, integrity, and alignment across all culture and entertainment marketing activities  

Social Intelligence 

Oversee social intelligence function that uses panoramic listening across social, search, behavioral, and emotional signals to answer key business questions and contribute to content strategy (e.g., inclusive of video, memes, etc.) and identify potential brand reputational risks Closely monitor industry trends and competitor activity to identify opportunities, including the identification of white spaces to illuminate the portfolio-level and brand-level messages Use audience lexicon + competitor voice + influential voices to determine where the Coffee Operating Unit brands can meaningfully and authentically participate in timely, cultural moments Use audience, community, and content insights for cross-channel and cross-platform planning Measurement & Management 

Track, analyze, and report on KPIs to monitor performance and ensure metrics are used to make data-driven decisions Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing team of professionals Work closely and collaboratively with other marketing and brand teams to extend social reach and determine balance between organic and paid promotion Track social and content to overall business goals, budget, and resources It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

 
Total Rewards:
Salary Range: $155,500 - $ 220,000Actual placement within the compensation range may vary depending on experience, skills, and other factorsBenefits, subject to election and eligibility: Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, Paid Time Off (including paid parental leave, vacation, and sick time), 401k with company match, Tuition Reimbursement, and Mileage ReimbursementAnnual bonus based on performance and eligibility 
Requirements:
Must possess a bachelor’s degree. An MBA is preferred, but not required  10+ years of social/influencer/PR experience with 5+ years in people management and leadership.  Experience with key social channels, including Meta, Pinterest and TikTok  Strong analytical skills; ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions and develop actionable recommendations  Experience leading social and cultural marketing teams and managing the full lifecycle of a brand experience Commercially and creatively minded  Excellent communication skills and the ability to work well alone as well as with different departments across the business  Process driven and demonstrated ability to deliver in a timely manner  Energetic, enthusiastic, proactive, and driven  A self-starter with respect for others’ points of view  
Company Overview:
Keurig Dr Pepper (Nasdaq: KDP) is a leading beverage company with more than 150 owned, licensed and partner brands that meet a wide range of needs and occasions. Our North American refreshment beverage business holds leadership positions across carbonated soft drinks, water, juice and mixers with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Dr Pepper®, Canada Dry®, Mott’s®, A&W®, Peñafiel®, GHOST®, 7UP®, Snapple®, Clamato® and Core Hydration®. Our global coffee business spans more than 100 markets and includes the leading Keurig® single-serve brewing system in the U.S. and Canada, along with powerhouse brands such as Peet’s, L’OR and Jacobs, and other regional coffee leaders. Our more than 50,000 employees aim to enhance the experience of every beverage and coffee occasion while making a positive impact for people, communities, and the planet.

We strive to be an employer of choice, providing culture and opportunities that empower our team to grow and develop. We offer robust benefits to support your health and wellness as well as your personal and financial well-being. We also provide employee programs designed to enhance your professional growth and development, while ensuring you feel valued, inspired and appreciated at work.

Whatever your area of expertise, at KDP you can be a part of a team that’s proud of its brands, partnerships, innovation and growth. Will you join us?

Keurig Dr Pepper is an equal opportunity employer and recruits qualified applicants and advances in employment its employees without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, disability or association with a person with a disability, medical condition, genetic information, ethnic or national origin, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

KDP uses artificial intelligence to assist with initial resume screening and candidate matching. This technology helps us efficiently identify candidates whose qualifications align with our open roles. AI does not make hiring decisions; all decisions throughout the hiring process are made by talent acquisition team members. If you prefer not to have your application processed using artificial intelligence, you may opt out by emailing your resume and qualifications directly to kdpjobs@kdrp.com in lieu of clicking Apply. In order for your application to be considered and opted out of AI, you must include the words "AI Opt-Out" and either job title and location or Job ID # in the email subject line in your email application.

directormarketingdigitalcustomerexperien.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

Job Title

Director, Marketing – Digital Customer Experience

Company

Prologis

A day in the life

The Director, Marketing – Digital Customer Experience will lead the strategy and evolution of Prologis’ global digital customer experience ecosystem with an AI-first transformation mindset. This role sits at the intersection of Marketing, Customer Experience, Technology, Data, and AI, translating business priorities into scalable digital capabilities that improve how customers, prospects, marketers, and internal teams engage with Prologis.

The Director will own the vision and roadmap across digital experience platforms, including web and CMS, property search, digital asset management, marketing automation, analytics, personalization, conversational experiences, and AI-enabled capabilities.

A core expectation of this role is to continually reimagine Digital Customer Experience through AI, automation, and data. The Director will challenge existing customer journeys, content operations, marketing workflows, search experiences, personalization, analytics, and team processes to determine where AI can simplify, automate, augment, or fundamentally redesign the way work gets done and experiences are delivered.

AI should be considered from the outset when defining new digital capabilities rather than added after solutions have been designed.

This leader will translate Prologis’ broader enterprise AI strategy into actionable Digital Customer Experience priorities and use cases, while partnering closely with Enterprise AI, Technology, Architecture, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and governance teams on shared platforms, standards, and responsible AI practices.

Key Responsibilities Include



Define and lead the global Digital Customer Experience strategy, roadmap, and priorities with AI, automation, data, and intelligent experiences embedded as foundational design principles.Continuously reimagine customer journeys, digital experiences, marketing operations, content workflows, search, personalization, analytics, and employee workflows through an AI-first lens.Identify, assess, and prioritize AI and automation opportunities across Digital Customer Experience based on customer and business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, effort, adoption readiness, and alignment with enterprise strategy.Lead AI-enabled Digital Customer Experience capabilities from discovery and experimentation through production, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement.Drive adoption of generative AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, personalization, automation, analytics, copilots, and agentic workflows where they create measurable customer or business value.Identify opportunities for AI agents and copilots within Digital Customer Experience and marketing workflows, define the product experience and business requirements, and partner with Enterprise AI and engineering teams on orchestration, tool access, guardrails, monitoring, and deployment.Manage digital platforms as products, with clear ownership, measurable outcomes, product roadmaps, continuous improvement, and strong customer and stakeholder feedback loops.Lead modernization of the global web and digital experience ecosystem, improving customer experience, marketer autonomy, content reuse, localization, accessibility, performance, scalability, and intelligent automation.Oversee the digital marketing technology portfolio, including CMS/DXP, property search, DAM, marketing automation, analytics, consent/tagging, search, personalization, and customer-facing integrations.Use data, experimentation, customer insights, and AI-driven analytics to improve digital journeys, engagement, conversion, operational efficiency, and decision-making.Partner with Enterprise AI, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Security, Legal, Data, Privacy, Procurement, and Vendor Management to ensure AI-enabled and digital solutions are scalable, secure, governed, responsible, and aligned with enterprise standards.Help shape practical enterprise AI patterns by bringing forward Digital Customer Experience requirements, use cases, lessons learned, and reusable capabilities.Partner with enterprise technology teams to leverage shared AI platforms, models, knowledge capabilities, agent frameworks, orchestration services, and integration patterns rather than creating duplicative solutions.Lead strategic vendor and implementation-partner relationships while maintaining Prologis ownership of product strategy, architecture decisions, customer experience, and institutional knowledge.Drive adoption and organizational change through experimentation, education, communications, training, new ways of working, and measurement of business outcomes.Build and develop a high-performing Digital Customer Experience team in which AI fluency, experimentation, data-driven decision-making, customer-centric product thinking, and continuous reinvention are expected capabilities across roles.Establish clear global and regional governance, prioritization, product ownership, and operating models.

Building blocks for success

Required

10+ years of experience in digital customer experience, digital product management, digital marketing, marketing technology, AI-enabled products, or a related field.Proven leadership of enterprise digital platforms or customer-facing digital products, including ownership of strategy, roadmaps, business outcomes, and organizational change.Demonstrated experience using AI to transform digital products, customer experiences, marketing operations, or business workflows, including moving AI-enabled capabilities from experimentation into production and measurable adoption.Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, RAG, conversational AI, intelligent search, personalization, AI agents, copilots, workflow automation, evaluation approaches, human-in-the-loop patterns, and responsible AI practices.Demonstrated ability to identify and prioritize AI opportunities based on customer value, business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, effort, and adoption readiness.Experience translating business and customer problems into AI-enabled product opportunities, requirements, experiments, and measurable outcomes.Strong experience working across Marketing, Product, Technology, Data, and AI organizations.Experience with CMS/DXP platforms, marketing automation, digital asset management, analytics, personalization, search, and customer journey design.Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, integrations, APIs, data, security, privacy, technology governance, and how these considerations affect AI-enabled products.Experience partnering with AI, engineering, architecture, data, security, privacy, and governance teams to move AI-enabled capabilities into enterprise production.Experience using data, experimentation, customer insight, and business metrics to evaluate product decisions and measure value.Experience leading global programs, vendors, budgets, roadmaps, and organizational change.Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, product leadership, and cross-functional leadership skills.Ability to balance innovation and experimentation with scalability, governance, customer experience, business value, and responsible technology practices.

Preferred

Experience deploying generative AI, conversational AI, intelligent search, personalization, copilots, or AI agents in customer-facing or employee-facing environments.Experience designing or managing AI-enabled products that use enterprise knowledge, RAG, tool integration, workflow automation, agentic patterns, or human-in-the-loop processes.Familiarity with AI evaluation, observability, guardrails, prompt and context management, and measurement of AI product quality.Experience with enterprise platforms such as Drupal, Adobe Experience Manager, Contentful, Sitecore, Marketo, Bynder, or comparable technologies.Experience leading large-scale digital modernization or AI-enabled transformation initiatives.Experience identifying where traditional digital experiences or workflows should be redesigned rather than simply enhanced with AI.Experience working within an enterprise AI operating model in which AI platforms, governance, and standards are centrally established while business and product teams own use-case discovery, product experience, adoption, and outcomes.Experience in a global B2B organization.

Hiring Salary Range Of

$149,000 - $205,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target & LTI (Long Term Incentives) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

People First

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. People come first here.

All full-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time.

All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

communicationsleadthecarreraagency.description:
The Internal Communications Lead will serve as a communications partner to Global Strategic Marketing (GSM) leadership, translating business priorities, transformation initiatives, and key updates into clear, consistent communications for the organization. This person combines strong judgment and exceptional writing with the ability to connect activity across multiple initiatives, bring structure to ambiguity, and turn broad direction into clear, finished communications.


Part-time contract role: up to 20 hrs/ week


Location
Remote
Duration
6 months (possible extension to 12 months)


Compensation
Starting at $80/hr W2
Responsibilities
Leadership Partnership & Communications Counsel:


Participate in relevant GSM leadership discussions and maintain visibility across major priorities and initiatives. Proactively identify communications needs and recommend the appropriate audience, message, channel, and timing.


Communications Planning & GSM Narrative:


Operationalize GSM’s internal communications approach and maintain a clear, consistent narrative connecting leadership priorities, transformation initiatives, milestones, business outcomes, and key wins. Maintain an integrated communications calendar and recommend communications based on emerging needs across GSM.


Transformation & Initiative Communications:


Partner with Change Management and initiative leaders to translate change plans into clear, coordinated communications. Develop messages, stakeholder communications, leader materials, FAQs, and communications cadences that support awareness, understanding, and adoption.


Leadership Messaging & Talking Points:


Develop executive communications, presentations, leadership updates, briefing materials, and reusable talking points that equip leaders and GSM team members to explain priorities and initiatives consistently.


Content Development, Storytelling & Wins:


Translate complex topics into clear, practical, and engaging communications for diverse audiences. Develop emails, Teams messages, presentations, FAQs, newsletters, leader materials, and stories that make GSM priorities, progress, and key wins visible and understandable.


Town Halls & Employee Engagement:


Support the planning and execution of town halls and employee engagement activities, including messaging, creative concepts, presentation development, speaker preparation, and follow-up communications.


Communications Operations & Channels:


Establish and maintain the working structure for GSM communications, including planning routines, intake and prioritization, editorial cadence, calendars, templates, content repositories, and channel delivery across Staffbase, Teams, SharePoint, email, and other employee communications platforms.


Measurement & Insights:


Monitor communications performance and employee feedback, using engagement data and insights to improve effectiveness and inform future communications.


Requirements
7+ years of relevant internal, corporate, or transformation communications experience, or equivalent experience demonstrating the ability to independently counsel leaders and execute communications in a complex organization.


Demonstrated ability to work independently from broad or incomplete direction.


Strong judgment about what needs to be communicated, to whom, when, and through which channel.


Ability to stay informed across multiple initiatives without needing to be the subject-matter expert for each.


Comfort participating in leadership discussions and handling confidential or evolving information.


Ability to connect disparate updates into a consistent organizational narrative.


Strong writing, editing, storytelling, and executive communications capabilities.


Experience supporting transformation, organizational change, or major business initiatives through communications.


Skilled at developing communications plans, leadership messaging, town halls, employee engagement activities, and channel content.


Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through.


Data-informed mindset and experience using communications metrics and feedback to improve effectiveness.


Equally comfortable advising leaders and producing the finished deliverables.


Highly proactive, low-ego, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities and information may evolve quickly.


Please apply today!
