seniormanagercommunicationspeakenergy.description:
Job Description 

 Job Description 



 Peak Energy 

 Job Title:  Senior Manager, Communications 
 Location:  Burlingame, California (In-person)
 Department:  Marketing 
 Reports To:  Director of Growth & Marketing 
 Position Type:  Full-time 

 

 About Peak Energy 

 Peak Energy is the first American venture to advance globally proven Sodium-Ion battery systems as the storage standard for the new era of renewable energy on a resilient grid. 

 Sodium-Ion is cheap, readily available and safe, making it the leading contender in a rapidly evolving market. 

 Our leadership team is powered by decades of expertise in scaling gigawatt-level innovation at world-class companies such as Tesla, Northvolt, Apple, Powin, Enovix, Zipline, Solid Power, and Fluence. We are backed by strategic investment and product partners such as TDK Ventures and Eclipse Ventures. 

 We are a team of engineers, operators, entrepreneurs, and partners driven by a shared ambition to set the new performance standard for renewable energy and grid resilience. 

 

 About the Role – Senior Manager, Communications 

 Peak Energy is looking for a Senior Manager, Communications to lead corporate communications, public relations, and product storytelling. 

 You will work closely with Peak's leadership team and across Marketing, Commercial, Product, and Engineering to shape how we communicate our company, technology, and products externally. You'll turn company priorities, customer insights, and complex technical inputs into clear, compelling narratives. 

 This is a hands-on role that spans strategy and execution. You will write press releases, develop messaging and media pitches, prepare executives for interviews, shape product positioning, and lead major announcements from initial strategy through launch. 

 

 What You'll Do (Responsibilities)

 Corporate Communications & Executive Communications 

 Develop and execute Peak's corporate communications and PR strategy. 

 Work directly with executives to develop messaging, talking points, presentations, and external narratives. 

 Write press releases, media pitches, FAQs, briefing materials, and executive communications. 

 Prepare executives for media interviews, speaking engagements, and major announcements. 

 Build media relationships and proactively drive earned coverage. 

 Manage Peak's external PR agency, including priorities, pitching strategy, and performance. 

 Positioning, Content & Storytelling 

 Develop and maintain Peak's corporate, technology, and product messaging. 

 Translate technical differentiation, customer insights, and market dynamics into clear value propositions and compelling external stories. 

 Partner with Commercial, Product, and Engineering to validate proof points, customer evidence, and technical claims. 

 Develop executive thought leadership and review technical explainers, case studies, white papers, and customer-facing content to ensure messaging alignment 

 Partner with executives and subject matter experts to develop differentiated points of view on key market topics. 

 Launches & Go-to-Market Communications 

 Lead communications for product launches, customer announcements, partnerships, financing, manufacturing milestones, and other major company news. 

 Partner with Government Affairs, Product, Commercial, and Engineering to translate GTM strategy into positioning, proof points, launch narratives, and supporting materials. 

 Own communications execution from narrative and content development through media strategy and external rollout. 

 What You'll Bring (Qualifications)

6–8+ years of experience in communications, PR, product communications, or a related role. 

 Exceptional writer and editor with extensive experience writing press releases, pitches, executive messaging, and long-form content. 

 Strong media relations experience and a track record of securing meaningful earned coverage. 

 Experience working directly with senior executives and the judgment and confidence to advise leadership on messaging and external communications. 

 Experience positioning and launching technical products, technologies, or major company initiatives. 

 Ability to translate complex technical and commercial information into clear, credible narratives and customer value propositions. 

 High ownership and ability to move between strategy and hands-on execution. 

 

 

 Preferred Qualifications 

 Significant PR agency experience strongly preferred, ideally combined with in-house experience. 

 Experience in energy, infrastructure, climate tech, industrial technology, or another technical industry strongly preferred. 

 Peak Energy is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We strongly encourage women, people of color, and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. We value skills, potential, and perspective over specific credentials. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't look perfect on paper, we still want to hear from you. 

 

 

 Our Core Values 

 Speed Through Focus  - Move fast but understand why. Focus on the goal, don't sacrifice quality. 

 Mission Over Self  - It's about the greater good; confident humility. Take ownership and accountability. 

 Face the Brutal Truth  - Transparency, honesty, big picture curiosity. Fearless decision making. 

 Be a Good Person  - Kindness, collaboration and teamwork. 

 

 

 Compensation & Benefits 

 The salary range for this role is $120,000-$200,000 , with actual pay varying based on work location, experience, and skills. Our competitive benefits package includes: 

 Flexible time off 

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage 

 Strong 401(k) plan 

 Equity opportunities 

 Many great work perks 

 Join us to thrive in a supportive environment while making a meaningful impact in the energy sector!

 At Peak Energy Technologies Inc., we believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace makes us a more capable, innovative, and competitive company. We welcome people who represent diversity in their backgrounds, ethnicities, cultures, and experiences. Peak Energy Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer, aiming to reach our company's full potential by cultivating an inclusive workforce. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Check out this video and find out why our team loves to work here! (https://www.cdmsmith.com/resources/videos/meet-cdm-smith)


**Join Us! CDM Smith – where amazing career journeys unfold.**


Imagine a place committed to offering an unmatched employee experience. Where you work on projects that are meaningful to you. Where you play an active part in shaping your career journey. Where your co-workers are invested in you and your success. Where you are encouraged and supported to do your very best and given the tools and resources to do so. We value passionate individuals who challenge the norm, deliver world-class solutions and bring diverse perspectives. Join our team, and together we will make a difference and change the world.


**Job Description**


Are you a recent graduate specializing in communications, political science, public policy, or a related field? Are you interested in transportation, the environment, and infrastructure? This is an exciting opportunity to join CDM Smith's Transportation Advisory Services, a multi-disciplinary team of experts, including senior policy and communications specialists, to help our transportation clients identify, analyze, and solve their public policy issues and challenges, especially funding, and potentially also including technology, energy, emissions, and equity. Examples of specific work tasks include:


+ Conducting in-depth financial analysis of transportation revenue and spending projections


+ Analyzing stakeholders including policy positions, influences, priorities, and authorities


+ Designing and conducting stakeholder and community outreach to solicit input on policy proposals


+ Researching, analyzing, and summarizing statutes and regulations


+ Researching, tracking, and analyzing bills

+ Coordinating input on policy proposals from task forces, working groups, and other stakeholders as directed by clients


+ Designing policy proposals and solutions to address client and stakeholder objectives and constraints


+ Authoring papers and memoranda that frame policy issues including alternative solutions, trade-offs, and considerations


+ Drafting bill language to align with client priorities for policy proposals


+ Presenting findings and recommendations to working groups, task forces, legislative committees, other public bodies, and the public

+ Working understanding of top transportation public policy challenges facing U.S. federal, state, and local governments, including funding, technology, energy, emissions, and equity

Banner Health believes leadership matters. We look for people who share our vision making health care easier, so life can be better. Our leaders are at the front of the health care transformation, planning the future of Banner Health.

Banner Health has earned Great Place To Work® Certification™ for the third consecutive year. We’re committed to a workplace culture where team members trust the people they work for, take genuine pride in their work, and enjoy collaborating with colleagues.

As the Director of Digital Marketing, you will establish and execute comprehensive digital channel strategies that make a real, measurable impact across owned and organic platforms. You will have the opportunity to thrive in a cross-functional environment where your leadership influences teams, partners and outcomes across the organization.

Your pay and benefits are important components of your journey at Banner Health. This opportunity includes the option to participate in a variety of health, financial, and security benefits. In addition, this position may be eligible for our Management Incentive Program as part of your Total Rewards package.

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

Position Summary

This position is responsible for leading strategy, execution, and optimization across Banner Health's owned and organic digital marketing channels including email, social media, SEO/AEO, and emerging channels. Serves as the cross-channel orchestrator who ensures integrated, data-driven digital marketing activation that reaches audiences with coordinated messaging and optimized customer experiences. This role establishes digital channel strategies, leads campaign execution, drives performance and conversion optimization, and builds the organizational capability to execute sophisticated digital marketing at scale. Drives measurable results through owned and organic digital channels, and by building organizational capability in a matrixed, collaborative environment.

Core Functions

 Leads digital marketing planning and cross-channel orchestration for integrated campaigns. Partners with service line marketing teams to understand integrated marketing plans and business objectives. Works across Consumer Digital Engagement channel leaders including content, web, and marketing technology. Coordinates with paid media teams to create and document comprehensive digital marketing activation plans. Translates service line objectives into executable digital strategies that coordinate owned and organic channels with paid media efforts. Ensures digital marketing efforts are strategically aligned, properly sequenced, and optimized for maximum impact. Establishes campaign timelines, channel responsibilities, and success metrics. Orchestrates cross-channel execution to deliver cohesive customer experiences across email, social, web, and paid channels in partnership with the advertising team.  Owns enterprise email marketing strategy, execution, and optimization. Develops email marketing strategies that drive awareness, engagement, conversion, and loyalty across consumer and patient audiences. Partners with the Email Marketing to execute campaigns including promotional emails, nurture journeys, triggered messaging, and lifecycle communications. Collaborates with Content Strategy & Operations for messaging, and MarTech & Digital Experience for template design, audience segmentation, journey automation, and technical execution. Establishes email best practices, deliverability standards, and compliance protocols. Drives continuous optimization through A/B testing, performance analysis, and audience refinement. Grows email subscriber base and engagement metrics.  Owns enterprise social media strategy, execution, and community management. Develops organic social media strategies across platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and emerging platforms. Partners with Social Media to create content calendars, execute posts, engage with audiences, and manage community interactions. Collaborates with Content Strategy & Operations for messaging and creative assets. Establishes social media governance, brand voice guidelines, and crisis response protocols. Monitors social listening, sentiment, and trends. Drives audience growth, engagement, and conversion through organic social tactics. Manages social media tools, platforms, and vendor relationships.  Owns SEO/AEO strategy and organic search optimization. Develops search engine optimization (SEO) and answer engine optimization (AEO) strategies to improve Banner Health's visibility in organic search results and AI-powered answer engines. Executes or directs execution of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content optimization, and local search strategies. Collaborates with Content Strategy & Operations on SEO-optimized content and with Web Production & UX on technical implementation. Conducts keyword research, competitive analysis, and search performance monitoring. Drives organic search traffic growth, search rankings improvement, and featured snippet/AI answer optimization. Manages SEO tools, platforms, and vendor relationships.  Explores and pilots emerging digital channels and innovative marketing tactics. Stays current on emerging digital platforms, channels, and marketing technologies. Evaluates new channels (e.g., TikTok, Threads, emerging social platforms) for strategic fit and audience opportunity. Pilots innovative tactics including influencer partnerships, user-generated content, interactive experiences, and new content formats. Tests emerging AI-powered marketing capabilities and automation opportunities. Recommends channel expansion or investment based on performance data and strategic alignment. Brings innovation mindset to digital marketing execution and continuous improvement.  Drives performance optimization and conversion rate improvement across digital channels. Establishes measurement frameworks, KPIs, and success metrics for all digital marketing channels. Analyzes channel performance, audience behavior, and campaign effectiveness. Identifies optimization opportunities and implements testing strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and ROI. Partners with MarTech & Digital Experience on conversion rate optimization (CRO) for bannerhealth.com, providing strategic direction for testing roadmaps. Collaborates with Consumer Insights & Marketing Operations on analytics, reporting, and data-driven decision making. Fosters culture of testing, learning, and continuous improvement across the digital marketing team.  Builds and leads a high-performing digital marketing team. Recruits, hires, and onboards digital marketing team members including channel specialists and program managers. Provides leadership, coaching, and professional development to build team capabilities. Sets clear goals, expectations, and performance standards. Conducts performance reviews and career development planning. Fosters collaborative, innovative team culture focused on results and continuous learning. Develops team expertise in digital marketing best practices, emerging trends, and platform capabilities. Ensures team has resources, tools, and support needed to execute effectively.  Manages digital marketing channel budgets, vendors, and agency relationships. Develops and manages budgets for digital marketing tools, platforms, and vendor services. Evaluates and selects marketing technology platforms including social media management tools, SEO platforms, email service providers, and analytics tools. Manages vendor and agency relationships for specialized services including social listening, influencer marketing, SEO consulting, and content production. Negotiates contracts, manages performance, and ensures vendor accountability. Optimizes budget allocation across channels based on performance and strategic priorities.  Partners across Consumer Digital Engagement, Marketing, and cross-functional teams to ensure integrated execution. Collaborates closely with Content Strategy & Operations to align messaging and content across channels. Partners with MarTech & Digital Experience to ensure platform enablement, data integration, and technical execution support. Coordinates with media teams to align owned, organic, and channel strategies for integrated campaigns. Works with Consumer Insights & Marketing Operations on measurement, analytics, and reporting. Engages with Brand, Compliance, and Communications to ensure brand consistency and regulatory compliance. Serves as digital marketing subject matter expert and strategic advisor to service line marketing teams and organizational leadership. 

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.

7+ years of progressive digital marketing experience with demonstrated expertise across multiple channels including email, social media, and SEO.

5+ years of leadership experience building and managing high-performing marketing teams.

Proven track record developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies that drive measurable business results. Deep expertise in email marketing strategy, execution, and optimization including segmentation, automation, and lifecycle marketing. Strong background in organic social media marketing across multiple platforms including content strategy, community management, and audience growth. Solid understanding of SEO/AEO principles, technical SEO, content optimization, and organic search strategies. Experience with digital marketing planning, campaign orchestration, and cross-channel integration. Experience with marketing automation platforms, social media management tools, SEO platforms, and analytics tools.

Demonstrated ability to translate business objectives into executable digital marketing strategies and activation plans. Strong analytical skills with experience establishing KPIs, analyzing performance data, and driving optimization decisions. Experience managing digital marketing budgets, vendor relationships, and agency partnerships. Proven ability to work collaboratively in matrixed organizations and partner across multiple teams and functions. Excellent communication and presentation skills with ability to influence stakeholders at all levels. Player-coach mentality with ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on execution.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field.

Certifications in digital marketing, email marketing, social media, or SEO.

12+ years of digital marketing experience in healthcare, consumer services, or regulated industries.

Healthcare Or Consumer Marketing Experience Strongly Preferred.

Experience in large, complex healthcare organizations or integrated delivery networks.

Knowledge of HIPAA compliance and healthcare marketing regulations.

Deep expertise in conversion rate optimization (CRO) and testing methodologies.

Experience with customer data platforms (CDPs), marketing automation, and martech stack optimization.

Background in emerging channels and innovative digital marketing tactics including influencer marketing, user-generated content, and interactive experiences.

Experience With AI-powered Marketing Tools And Automation Capabilities.

Proven success growing digital audiences and engagement metrics at scale.

Strong project management skills with experience managing complex, multi-channel campaigns.

Experience establishing marketing operations, workflows, and governance frameworks.

Background in content strategy and messaging development.

Familiarity with paid media strategies and integrated campaign planning.

Experience with web analytics platforms (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics).

Track record of innovation and staying ahead of digital marketing trends.

Additional Related Education And/or Experience Preferred.

At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.

But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose.





Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.




Position Summary

The Marketing Manager supports the execution of commercial marketing initiatives and user experience programs for Caris’ oncology diagnostics portfolio. This position coordinates the development, review, production, distribution, and maintenance of customer-facing marketing materials and laboratory support collateral. The Marketing Manager also helps capture, organize, and communicate customer feedback to support continuous improvement initiatives.



Working under the direction of the Senior Director, this individual partners with Marketing, Product Management, Laboratory Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Supply Chain, and external creative partners to ensure materials are accurate, compliant, visually consistent, and delivered on time.



The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, collaborative, and passionate about creating an exceptional customer experience through effective coordination, communication, and execution.



Job Responsibilities


Coordinate the development, review, approval, production, distribution, and maintenance of customer-facing marketing materials.
Manage timelines and deliverables for commercial collateral, ensuring projects progress efficiently through review, approval, and production.
Partner with internal stakeholders and external creative agencies to develop high-quality marketing materials that align with brand standards and business objectives.
Maintain version control and organization of marketing assets to ensure teams have access to current, approved materials.
Coordinate the development and maintenance of laboratory support materials, including: Test Request Forms, Specimen requirement guides, Collection instructions, Kit inserts, Provider reference materials, Patient-facing educational materials, Laboratory collateral
Work closely with graphic designers to translate technical and clinical content into clear, user-friendly materials.
Coordinate updates to collection kits, printed components, packaging materials, labels, and specification sheets.
Partner with Laboratory Operations, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs, Medical Affairs, Supply Chain, and external vendors to ensure materials remain accurate, compliant, and current.
Support user experience initiatives by coordinating the collection, organization, and documentation of feedback from healthcare providers, laboratory partners, patients, and commercial teams.
Develop and maintain standardized processes for collecting, categorizing, and tracking customer feedback across multiple channels.
Organize and analyze customer insights to identify trends, recurring pain points, and opportunities to improve the customer experience.
Support the prioritization of user experience enhancements by maintaining feedback logs, dashboards, and reporting tools.
Coordinate cross-functional review sessions to communicate customer insights and track progress on improvement initiatives.
Coordinate meetings, project timelines, and follow-up activities across multiple departments.
Track deliverables, approvals, and action items to ensure projects remain organized and on schedule.
Facilitate communication among Marketing, Laboratory Operations, Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Product Management, and external partners.
Identify potential risks or delays and communicate them proactively to the Senior Director.

Required Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
Three to five years of experience in marketing, marketing coordination, healthcare communications, or a related role.
Strong organizational and project coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
Experience coordinating creative projects with internal stakeholders and external design partners.
Exceptional attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to producing high-quality deliverables.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, and Outlook, with a general working knowledge of the Internet for business use.

Preferred Qualifications


Experience in oncology, diagnostics, biotechnology, healthcare, or life sciences.
Familiarity with laboratory workflows, diagnostic testing, or regulated healthcare marketing.
Experience supporting Voice of Customer, customer experience, or user experience initiatives.
Experience using project management and collaboration platforms such as Smartsheet, Asana, or similar tools.

Answers calls and, as appropriate, provides verbal instructions, assistance and information; directs for action all 9-1-1 lines, and Police and Fire emergency lines according to standard procedures.Quickly assesses type, nature and status of emergency or non-emergency call and dispatches for priority follow-up to Police, Fire, EMS, Animal Control, and other City departments.Answers and relays teletype messages, radio messages, mobile data messages, intercom messages and interoffice messages.Monitors multiple radio frequencies and operates equipment within standard and non-standard emergency and non-emergency situations and conditions.Monitors City and other security alarm systems and, when an emergency occurs, notifies and dispatches the appropriate City assistance.Operates computer systems to enter City and Criminal Investigation Division (CID) warrants; logs in to Texas Crime Information Center (TCIC), National Crime Information Center (NCIC), and regional and Tarrant County computer systems to monitor and maintain up-to-date records on stolen items, vehicles, checks and wanted individuals, etc.Records and maintains department activity records.Performs related duties as directed when such duties are a logical and appropriate assignment to the position.Regular and timely attendance are required for this position.Interacts professionally and respectfully with the public, coworkers and others in the course of daily work.Required Skills:
Skills, knowledge and abilities:


Must be able to use judgement (developed through education, training and experience) and standard operating procedures to segregate calls by their emergency or non-emergency status.Ability to elicit information from callers who are under considerable stress.Good typing skills, particularly with numbers, and prefer familiarity with computer and radio operations and communications equipment.Requires consistent use of analysis, mental judgment, and discretion often at a very rapid pace due to workload demands that can result in a high pressure/high stress work climate.Must have the ability to multi-task.Must demonstrate excellent interpersonal, written communication, leadership, and decision-making/problem solving skills.Ability to work rotating shifts, weekends and holidays.Education, experience and other requirements:High school diploma or equivalent. Requires Basic Telecommunicator License and passing of State licensing test issued by Texas Commission on Law Enforcement (TCOLE) within one year of hire.Due to Criminal Justice Information Security (CJIS) requirements, the candidate must never have been convicted, put on court-ordered community supervision, or probation for any criminal offense above the grade of Class B misdemeanor or a Class B misdemeanor within the last ten years from the date of the court order. Class A Misdemeanor Conviction, Deferred Adjudication or Felony Conviction are permanent disqualifiers.All applicants must pass department required testing, oral interview board, and drug/physical screening.Must pass a Federal/National criminal background investigation and credit check, psychological screening, and polygraph exam.Must have a valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record as defined by City policy and the ability to obtain a Texas driver's license in accordance with Texas State law.Must pass a pre-employment physical, drug screen, Titmus vision screening, Ishihara vision screening, and audio (whisper test) screening.Working Conditions:
While performing the essential functions of this position the employee is rarely exposed to disagreeable environmental factors. Works under stress when confronted with emergency, critical, or dangerous situations; performs a variety of tasks, often changing from one task to another of a different nature without loss of efficiency or composure; works without constant supervision; courteously assists citizens and the general public and other employees with situations that are frequently complicated or serious in nature; maintains confidentiality with criminal and investigative information; and must concentrate on assigned tasks through many distractions. Works flexible hours to include all shifts; nights, weekends, and holidays and accept on-call duty status.


Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the essential functions of this job the employee is regularly required to perform light to medium work that involves walking or standing, use the computer keyboard and mouse, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, talk and hear, stand, walk, and stoop, or crouch. This position requires occasionally lifting and/or moving up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.


This job requires the ability to work in an office environment where the noise level is usually moderate.

Overview

At Colliers Engineering & Design (CED), our mission is to advance the built environment to accelerate the success of our communities, clients, and people. Guided by our vision to lead the industry through expertise, innovation, and sustainable solutions, the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) plays a critical role in realizing that ambition.


As a key member of the leadership team, the CMO drives a strategic, insight-driven, and client-focused marketing function that connects business goals, brand strategy, and client engagement across all markets and disciplines. This role ensures that marketing is a core driver of growth, innovation, and alignment across the enterprise.

 

Partnering closely with the CEO and executive leadership, the CMO aligns marketing strategy with firmwide business objectives and market intelligence, building the structure, systems, and talent needed to support CED’s continued expansion. Leading a multidisciplinary organization spanning Public Relations, Communications, Brand and Design, Digital Strategy, Marketing Technology, Market Strategists, and regional marketing teams, the CMO ensures integrated marketing and business development efforts that elevate visibility, engagement, and growth across all divisions.

 

Please note that candidates who are not based in our Holmdel, NJ headquarters will be required to travel to the office as needed.

 
Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Alignment

Develop and execute a firmwide marketing strategy aligned with CED’s mission and vision for leadership through innovation and expertise.Serve as a strategic advisor and trusted partner to the CEO and executive team, ensuring marketing informs business planning, growth, and integration.Design and implement scalable systems, processes, and playbooks to drive consistency and efficiency across divisions.Align marketing priorities and investments with the firm’s highest-value opportunities to achieve measurable ROI.Embed CED’s purpose and values into all marketing activities to reinforce a trusted, unified brand.People, Structure & Development

Build and sustain a high-performing marketing organization with clear roles, accountability, and capabilities aligned to business goals.Lead with integrity and agility, positioning marketing as a trusted, strategic partner in firmwide growth.Develop leadership depth and succession pipelines through mentorship and professional growth opportunities.Foster a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and accountability that empowers marketers to innovate and deliver results.Brand Strategy & Market Positioning

Lead the ongoing evolution of the CED brand to ensure consistency, relevance, and differentiation across markets.Champion a compelling brand narrative highlighting CED’s technical excellence, innovative spirit, and community impact.Ensure the quality and consistency of brand assets, messaging, and storytelling across all channels.Connect CED’s work to its broader purpose through authentic storytelling, thought leadership, and client engagement.Innovation, Insights & Technology

Promote a culture of innovation, encouraging new ideas, tools, and approaches that drive performance.Stay at the forefront of marketing, communications, and client engagement trends to maintain CED’s competitive edge.Champion marketing technologies, automation, and analytics to enhance scalability and data-driven decisions.Leverage research, benchmarking, and client insights to anticipate opportunities and inform strategy.Marketing Performance & Effectiveness

Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure marketing effectiveness and impact.Use analytics and insights to optimize strategies, resources, and client engagement outcomes.Drive budget discipline and ROI accountability to ensure marketing investments deliver business value.Promote transparency and continuous improvement across marketing operations.Cross-Functional Collaboration

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, or Business; MBA or advanced degree preferred.15+ years of senior marketing leadership experience in complex, multi-division organizations; experience in growth or transformation environments preferred.Demonstrated experience in the AEC industry, preferably within engineering and/or architecture organizations preferred.Prior experience working in a large, complex firm environment is strongly preferred. “Large” is defined as organizations with 2,500+ employees, multi-office national footprints, and multiple service lines, divisions, or market sectors.Experience supporting or operating within a high-growth organization, including exposure to mergers and acquisitions, integration efforts, or rapid scaling initiatives, is highly desirable and considered a strong differentiator.Proven success developing and executing integrated marketing strategies that drive measurable business growth.Deep understanding of brand strategy, client engagement, and data-driven marketing, ideally within professional services or related industries.Strong business acumen with expertise in financial management, performance metrics, and ROI analysis.Exceptional leadership, communication, and change management skills; able to inspire and align diverse teams.Demonstrated ability to balance strategic vision with disciplined execution across functions and markets.Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

At Colliers Engineering & Design, our people are our most important resource. That’s why we are committed to providing all our employees with a safe, comfortable work environment, potential for career advancement, and the ability to impact society through their projects as well as Company sponsored activities.

We have also created an internal culture that provides the resources and technology needed to encourage personal and professional growth opportunities through reimbursement for education; a free in-house resource for hundreds of educational and self-enrichment courses; mentorship program; wellness program; Women’s Organization and ongoing philanthropic opportunities.


Apply today to learn how you can join our team of professionals, so we can help you Accelerate Your Success!

digitalmarketingstrategisteicagency.description:
Mission

Take over day-to-day performance strategy, measurement, launch readiness, and delivery prioritization for a defined portfolio of EIC's white-label and platform clients. The goal is to move the founder from routine client-delivery decisions, diagnosis, and QA into exception review while helping Account Managers communicate clearly and Ad Managers execute the approved strategy correctly.

This is a hands-on growth role, not a reporting-only or hands-off consulting position. We want someone with strong fundamentals, technical curiosity, ownership, and the humility to learn EIC's approach. The Manager must be willing to investigate abnormal performance, enter unfamiliar platforms, debug tracking and integrations, and coach the team through implementation. Responsibility and autonomy will expand as judgment and trust are demonstrated.

The PodThe initial 90-day engagement is focused on one assigned pod rather than EIC's entire client roster.

The Manager quarterbacks the pod through strategy, prioritization, coaching, standards, and QA. Formal direct reports are not required initially, although people-management responsibility may develop as the role expands.

Account Manager: Owns client relationships, communication, timelines, and coordination.Ad Manager: Owns campaign builds, trafficking, daily optimization, testing, and routine execution.Performance Strategy & Analytics Manager: Owns business goals, channel and funnel strategy, weekly priorities, measurement, launch readiness, data quality, and final recommendations.Core ResponsibilitiesTranslate business goals into media strategy, including audience, offer, funnel, channel mix, budget, testing plan, and KPIs tied to client economics.Set the pod's weekly priorities by identifying the highest-impact risks and opportunities and turning them into a sequenced work queue for Account Managers and Ad Managers.Detect and diagnose performance problems across campaigns, creative, budgets, search terms, websites, forms, tracking, CRM, integrations, reporting, lead quality, and sales process.Direct recovery through an execution-ready plan with owners, dependencies, and acceptance criteria, then stay involved until the root cause is corrected and the result is verified in production.Own launch readiness across strategy, creative, targeting, budget, access, tracking, CRM handoff, reporting, and client approvals. Separate true blockers from work that can safely continue after launch.Own end-to-end measurement and data flow from ad platforms through websites, forms, call tracking, analytics, CRM, automation, qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and ROAS.Work directly inside platforms when complex setup, debugging, QA, recovery, or training requires it. Routine trafficking and daily optimization remain with the Ad Manager whenever practical.Lead client strategy conversations, quarterly recaps, media planning, and responsible forecasting using actual business performance, clear assumptions, and known constraints.Turn founder judgment into repeatable decision rules, QA standards, diagnostic processes, launch criteria, and escalation thresholds.What Success Looks LikeEvery account in the pod has an agreed business goal, funnel, KPI hierarchy, source of truth, and prioritized action plan.Material performance changes are identified early, investigated across the full system, and resolved at the root cause.Launches have verified tracking, CRM handoff, reporting, and optimization signals before avoidable problems reach the client.Account Managers know what to communicate, Ad Managers know what to execute and why, and clients understand the strategy and tradeoffs.Founder involvement moves from routine prioritization, diagnosis, and QA to defined exception review.Each quarter closes with a clear performance story and an evidence-based next-quarter plan and forecast.Required ExperienceApproximately 6–10 years across paid media strategy, account leadership, performance marketing, marketing operations, or related work. Capability and judgment matter more than a rigid year count.Deep working knowledge of Google Ads and Meta Ads, with sound judgment across channels such as LinkedIn, programmatic, geofencing, and retargeting.Hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager, pixels or server-side events, offline conversions, call tracking, and attribution.Ability to connect websites and forms with CRM, automation, and reporting systems through native integrations, APIs, or webhooks.Ability to audit campaign builds against strategy, diagnose anomalies, and turn findings into an execution-ready repair plan.Comfort with browser developer tools, tag debugging, cookie and network inspection, platform diagnostics, and CRM record tracing. Software engineering experience is not required.Experience translating complex performance into clear client narratives, quarterly plans, and responsible forecasts.Strong business acumen across conversion rates, sales capacity, CAC, LTV, payback, pipeline, revenue, and ROAS.Strong convictions loosely held, disciplined QA, clear communication, coachability, and calm ownership under pressure.How the Role GrowsFirst 30 days: Learn EIC's framework, shadow pod reviews, audit the assigned accounts, and learn the current platforms, commitments, and workflows.Days 31–60: Prepare weekly priorities, own analysis and recommendations for selected accounts, coach an Ad Manager through implementation, and lead part of a client strategy discussion.Days 61–90: Run the pod's weekly performance review, priority queue, launch and measurement QA, planning, and client strategy conversations, with the founder reviewing exceptions rather than building the answer.Long term: Expand account and team ownership as judgment, leverage, and business need are demonstrated.Compensation and StructurePaid 90-day, part-time engagement averaging approximately 15 hours per week.Starting compensation of $4,500–$5,500 per month, based on experience and demonstrated capability.Scope, responsibility, hours, and compensation will be formally reviewed at the end of the engagement.Path to a larger part-time or full-time role for someone who demonstrates the ability to independently own the pod.Hiring Proof PointsCandidates should be prepared to walk through:

A system they designed that connected ad spend to qualified pipeline or revenue.A material performance decline they diagnosed, including how they proved the root cause and validated recovery.A launch they kept on track despite access, tracking, CRM, reporting, or approval blockers.A campaign build that did not match strategy and the exact rebuild direction they provided.A recommendation they changed because CRM or business data contradicted platform data.A difficult client conversation that turned complex information into a clear decision.A time they coached an executor, documented the process, and reduced future escalations.An unfamiliar platform or system they learned quickly and how they verified the solution.

You've Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."


You didn't get into this to manage one piece of a project. You got into it to change how the world gets built.


At Accenture Construct, that's the job. You'll help deliver the data centers, power grids, rail networks, factories and public infrastructure that keep communities moving — smarter, safer and more sustainably.


You'll work alongside people who think big and act bold: project managers, engineers, technologists and strategists who pair real-world delivery with AI. And you won't be handed a slice of it. We take on whole programs, from early strategy through construction and handover, and we stand behind how they land.



Because “good enough” builds the past. You're here to build what's next.
 
Visit us here to learn more about ​Accenture Construct

As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Construct LLC or Accenture Construct Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.


THE WORK:

You'll lead day-to-day stakeholder engagement and communications programs supporting large-scale infrastructure and capital projects.
You'll serve as a trusted advisor to public agency clients, project teams, and contractors, providing strategic communications and stakeholder engagement guidance.
You'll develop and implement outreach strategies that foster understanding, address concerns, and maintain positive relationships with communities, businesses, elected officials, and other key stakeholders.

You'll develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and prepare progress reports to measure program effectiveness and communicate results to clients.
You'll identify stakeholder, reputational, and political risks and support the development of proactive mitigation strategies.
You'll build and maintain relationships with public agencies, contractors, teaming partners, and industry organizations throughout California.
You'll identify and support the pursuit of new business opportunities across transportation, transit, water, energy, and public infrastructure markets.
You'll lead and contribute to proposal development, qualifications packages, interview presentations, and grant applications.
You'll develop persuasive technical narratives, executive summaries, and win themes that strengthen pursuit strategies and proposal submissions.
You'll contribute to capture planning, market research, and account development activities that support business growth objectives.
You'll represent Accenture at industry events, conferences, and client meetings to strengthen market presence, expand relationships, and generate new opportunities.

From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data - from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We''re looking for an amazing individual to join Fivetran''s Employee Experience team as our Senior Lead, Employee Experience & Internal Communications. This role goes beyond writing great comms - you''ll also help design how employees experience Fivetran day to day, from how we listen to them, to how we recognize them, to how we bring them together as a community. You''ll craft compelling communications for employees around the world, build the frameworks that connect employees to one another and to our priorities, and design programs that make people feel heard, valued, and energized - all in service of our company mission.

You''ll be hands-on: writing stellar communications, designing employee listening mechanisms, building recognition programs, and running culture and community initiatives. You''ll also zoom out - building frameworks and cadences that scale, and using data (surveys, engagement metrics, attendance, participation) to tell a story about how the organization is doing and what to do next.

Google Suite, Notion

Internal Communications

Own the internal communications strategy, calendar, and multi-channel distribution framework, spanning both the People and COO organizations

Write and edit clear, engaging content for internal audiences across our internal wiki and other channels

Craft consistent messaging on company updates, initiatives, and achievements

Support leadership on change and reorg communications, ensuring transparency and buy-in

Manage and optimize internal communication channels (email, intranet, Slack, and other digital platforms)

Develop and maintain a crisis communications plan for unexpected events affecting the company and its employees

Employee Listening

Design and run an employee listening framework across employee groups (e.g., ERGs) and around key moments (e.g., reorgs), at a minimum quarterly cadence

Establish feedback mechanisms to gauge the effectiveness of communications and programs, and translate what you hear into action

Recognition

Build and document a company-wide recognition framework, pilot it with an initial team, and iterate based on results

Integrate recognition into everyday tools and processes (e.g., Slack, Workday) and align it with company values

Culture

Identify and help launch culture initiatives grounded in our top company values

Track and report on awareness and adoption (e.g., through the annual company survey)

Events & Community

Design a connection framework for events and community programming, including remote/distributed hubs

Plan and deliver company events (holiday, community, and milestone moments) with clear attendance and satisfaction goals

Data & Storytelling

Analyze and present data (survey results, attendance, engagement, participation) accurately and use it to tell a clear story that drives decisions

About the Team
DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. To further this mission, we’re looking for a marketer to join our Co-Marketing team focused on reaching the DoorDash Advertiser audience. 
Our Co-Marketing team partners with DoorDash's most valued Enterprise Advertisers to create integrated marketing programs that acquire new customers and drive sales and awareness for our mutual businesses. Our North Star is to be the most trusted and sought-after co-marketing partner for brands by creating groundbreaking marketing that delivers value to our mutual audiences, drives business impact for our Advertisers, and puts our brands at the center of culture.
About the Role
The Ads Co-Marketing team is looking for a strategic, entrepreneurial, and data-driven marketer to own and grow our co-marketing opportunities with DoorDash's leading Enterprise Restaurant partners. 
Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Restaurant Merchant Partnerships, you'll be the day-to-day owner for a book of Restaurant Advertisers - owning the relationship, strategy, and execution that keeps our partners engaged and growing on DoorDash. You'll work closely with Sales, Growth Marketing, and Creative Studio to ensure we're maximizing value from our partner relationships, with marketing that drives our partners' business forward and serves our shared audiences. This is a unique opportunity to help shape a fast-growing, global consumer brand through the lens of our partnerships.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Own and grow marketing relationships with some of our largest and most high-profile Enterprise Restaurant partners — serving as lead for co-marketing engagements, including annual/quarterly strategic planning, campaign execution, and alignment across internal and external stakeholders
Lead the strategy and execution of integrated co-marketing campaigns end-to-end — from concept and production through launch, optimization, and reporting — bringing strong operational rigor and organization to keep complex, multi-team campaigns on track, in close partnership with Sales, Creative, Paid Media, Social, and Operations teams
Apply a data-first mindset to measure, analyze, and continuously optimize campaign performance — delivering clear, actionable readouts (internal and partner-facing) tied to success measures like ads revenue growth, merchant growth, incremental order volume, and advertiser engagement and retention
Bring the restaurant advertiser's point of view into broader conversations across DoorDash Marketing — helping shape new co-marketing opportunities and supporting the sales team in pitching them to partners when needed
Manage campaign budgets, including spend tracking, pacing, and accrual preparation, to ensure efficient investment and strong ROI

We’re excited about you because you have…

6+ years of B2C marketing at a consumer brand, tech company, media agency, or consultancy, with a mix of performance, retention, and consulting experience; MBA a plus.
A proven track record of owning marketing programs end-to-end — from goal-setting and strategy through execution, optimization, and performance reporting — with hands-on experience across paid media platforms (e.g., Google, Meta, TikTok) and CRM channels in a client- or partner-facing environment; restaurant industry experience a plus.
Strong analytical skills, including market and segment sizing, forecasting, and using data to inform decisions and optimize performance.
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills — including experience partnering with a sales or sales/marketing organization to drive advertiser outcomes across Marketing, Sales, Strategy & Operations, Analytics, Product, and Creative teams.
A creative, entrepreneurial mindset — comfortable solving ambiguous problems and building solutions in fast-paced, resource-constrained environments.

Western States Metal Roofing
 

 Location: Phoenix, Arizona — On-Site, Full-Time
 

 Salary: $75,000 annually
 

 Reports To: Director of Marketing
 

 

 About Western States Metal Roofing
 

 

 Western States Metal Roofing is a leading provider of metal roofing and siding products serving contractors, architects, builders, homeowners, and commercial customers across the United States.
 

 

 Our marketing team supports a growing national brand through digital marketing, content, SEO, paid media, email, social media, video, website strategy, sales enablement, trade shows, product campaigns, and lead generation.
 

 

 As our marketing organization continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, proactive Marketing Project Manager who can help bring structure, accountability, and visibility to our marketing initiatives.
 

 

 Position Overview
 

 

 Western States Metal Roofing is seeking an experienced Marketing Project Manager to manage the planning, coordination, execution, and delivery of marketing projects across the organization.
 

 

 This role will be responsible for managing the marketing team’s workflow in Monday.com, keeping projects on schedule, coordinating across internal teams and external vendors, identifying bottlenecks, managing deadlines, and ensuring projects move from idea to completion efficiently.
 

 

 The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable managing multiple priorities, and capable of working closely with creative, digital, content, sales, product, operations, and leadership teams.
 

 

 This is a hands-on project management role. The Marketing Project Manager will not simply track tasks—they will actively drive projects forward, hold stakeholders accountable, surface risks early, and help the Director of Marketing maintain visibility into priorities, workload, deadlines, and results.
 

 

 Key Responsibilities
 

 

 Manage the marketing department’s project management system in Monday.com.
 

 Build, maintain, and improve project boards, workflows, dashboards, automations, dependencies, templates, and reporting.
 

 Create clear project plans with deliverables, owners, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deadlines.
 

 Coordinate projects across marketing functions including:
 

 Content marketing
 

 SEO
 

 Paid media
 

 Email marketing
 

 HubSpot campaigns
 

 Website projects
 

 Video production
 

 Graphic design
 

 Sales materials
 

 Product launches
 

 Trade shows and events
 

 Vendor projects
 

 Lead generation campaigns
 

 Manage campaign timelines from kickoff through launch and post-campaign review.
 

 Lead project kickoff meetings and clearly define scope, responsibilities, milestones, and deadlines.
 

 Run regular marketing project-status meetings.
 

 Follow up with project owners and stakeholders to keep deliverables moving.
 

 Identify schedule risks, scope changes, resource conflicts, and bottlenecks before they impact deadlines.
 

 Escalate project risks and unresolved issues to the Director of Marketing as needed.
 

 Maintain accurate project documentation, meeting notes, action items, approvals, and decisions.
 

 Ensure creative assets, copy, approvals, tracking, landing pages, emails, forms, reporting, and sales enablement materials are completed before campaign launch.
 

 Coordinate with internal departments such as Sales, Operations, Product, IT, and Leadership.
 

 Manage communication and timelines with outside agencies, freelancers, printers, developers, photographers, videographers, and other vendors.
 

 Track vendor deliverables and ensure projects stay within agreed scope and schedule.
 

 Support marketing budget tracking and project-level cost visibility.
 

 Help manage marketing calendars, campaign calendars, editorial calendars, trade-show schedules, and product-launch schedules.
 

 Monitor team capacity and help prioritize projects based on business impact.
 

 Maintain visibility into competing priorities and help the Director of Marketing make resource-allocation decisions.
 

 Develop repeatable processes, templates, checklists, and standard operating procedures.
 

 Conduct post-project reviews to identify what worked, what did not, and how future projects can be improved.
 

 Maintain centralized documentation for marketing processes, project standards, and workflows.
 

 Ensure projects align with larger marketing and revenue objectives.
 

 Support reporting on project completion, campaign readiness, delays, workload, and operational efficiency.
 

 Help improve cross-functional communication between Marketing and Sales.
 

 Monday.com Ownership
 

 

 This role will serve as the primary owner of Monday.com for the marketing department.
 

 

 Responsibilities will include:
 

 

 Creating and managing project boards
 

 Building reusable project templates
 

 Maintaining status definitions and naming conventions
 

 Creating automations and notifications
 

 Managing dependencies and timelines
 

 Building dashboards for leadership visibility
 

 Tracking overdue tasks and project risks
 

 Maintaining campaign and content calendars
 

 Monitoring workload and team capacity
 

 Improving adoption and consistency across the marketing team
 

 Training team members on proper Monday.com usage
 

 Ensuring project information stays accurate and current
 

 The goal is to make Monday.com the central source of truth for marketing projects.
 

 

 Required Qualifications
 

 

 3+ years of project management, marketing operations, campaign management, or related experience.
 

 Experience managing multiple marketing projects simultaneously.
 

 Strong hands-on experience with Monday.com or a comparable project-management platform.
 

 Strong understanding of marketing workflows and campaign execution.
 

 Experience coordinating projects across creative, digital, content, web, social, and sales teams.
 

 Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
 

 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 

 Ability to manage deadlines and hold team members and stakeholders accountable.
 

 Strong attention to detail.
 

 Ability to identify risks, dependencies, and potential project delays.
 

 Experience managing outside vendors or agencies.
 

 Comfortable working with multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 

 Strong problem-solving skills.
 

 Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects.
 

 Comfortable communicating with both individual contributors and senior leadership.
 

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
 

 Compensation amp; Benefits
 

 

 $75,000 annual salary
 

 Full-time position
 

 On-site at our Phoenix, Arizona campus
 

 Competitive employee benefits package
 

 Paid time off
 

 Company holidays
 

 Health and other employee benefits
 

 Opportunities for professional growth and increased responsibility
 

 Work Schedule
 

 

 This is a full-time, on-site position based at our Phoenix campus.
 

 

 The Marketing Project Manager will work closely with the Director of Marketing and collaborate across the organization to ensure marketing projects are properly planned, prioritized, executed, and completed.
 

 

 Apply
 

 

 If you are highly organized, enjoy managing complex projects, are comfortable holding teams accountable, and want to help build a more efficient and scalable marketing organization, we would like to hear from you.
 

 

 Please submit your resume and include examples of marketing projects, campaigns, or project-management systems you have managed.

On the Waymo Marketing team, you will help to connect people with the magic and impact of Waymo's autonomous driving technology. Our team has the unique opportunity to not only grow Waymo's brand from the ground up, but to also build societal acceptance for autonomous driving technology for the first time in history. We build thoughtful marketing strategy, positioning, messaging and creative assets to deliver messages that matter to our audience, communicated through anything from video content, to social media interactions, to immersive physical experiences. Spearhead US and select global experiential marketing strategies, driving high-impact initiatives from concept through execution.
Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of sponsorships and partnerships, leading property identification, strategic alignment, commercial negotiations, and on-site brand experiences.
Drive end-to-end event-based strategy defining target audience segments, determining optimal event formats and scale, and establishing clear measurement frameworks to drive business impact.
Serve as the steward of Waymo’s brand vision, translating brand strategy into immersive, world-class experiences that foster public trust in autonomous technology.
Lead event sponsorship deal structuring and contract negotiations partnering with cross-functional partners, legal and finance teams to maximize asset value, ensure favorable commercial terms, and protect brand interests across all agreements.
Mobilize leadership and cross-functional teams behind event priorities, securing rapid approvals through clear, proactive communication to execute at speed.
Manage program budgets with attention to detail, optimizing resource allocation and vendor negotiations to deliver premium activations with high cost-efficiency.

You Have: 



10+ years in an event specific role leading high-impact experiences in the US.
Deep knowledge of the region’s experiential landscape, with a strong understanding of regional event industry trends and audiences.
Extensive experience navigating the event sponsorship ecosystem, with a proven ability to evaluate value, negotiate high-stakes agreements, and oversee seamless on-site asset delivery.
Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex initiatives simultaneously.
A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality with the flexibility to jump into operational, creative, or logistical functions to keep projects moving forward as we scale the team.
A natural ability to balance high-level strategy with hands-on tactical execution, seamlessly pivoting across shifting priorities and expanding project scopes.

Global sponsorship experience. 
Experience in the autonomous vehicle, mobility, or a similarly highly regulated, pioneering technology sector.
Experience thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

30% - Willing to travel globally as required

Responsibilities
Functional Area 1: Strategic & Institutional Communications
Percent Effort: 35% Develop and execute comprehensive communications strategies that advance university priorities, including enrollment, student success, research, advancement, community engagement, and institutional reputation. Establish and maintain a cohesive institutional voice and messaging framework across communications channels. Provide strategic communications counsel to university leadership on institutional initiatives, announcements, sensitive issues, and emerging opportunities.


Develop executive communications, including speeches, talking points, presentations, statements, correspondence, and other leadership messaging. Oversee institutional communications and major publications, ensuring content is accurate, compelling, audience-focused, and aligned with university priorities. Percent Effort: 25% Serve as the university’s primary media relations contact and spokesperson, as appropriate. Develop and maintain strong relationships with local, regional, national, and industry-specific media. Lead proactive media outreach and story development highlighting faculty expertise, research, student success, institutional accomplishments, community impact, and university priorities.

Develop, maintain, and regularly evaluate the university’s crisis communications plan, protocols, templates, and response procedures. Serve as the communications lead within the university’s Incident Command structure during emergencies and significant incidents.

Monitor media, social media, and public conversation during emerging issues and crises and recommend appropriate responses. Conduct post-incident communications reviews and incorporate lessons learned into future crisis planning. Maintain appropriate after-hours availability for time‑sensitive emergencies and reputational matters.

Partner with Marketing, Creative Services, Web, Enrollment, Advancement, academic units, and other university teams to coordinate integrated storytelling and communications. Identify opportunities to elevate faculty expertise and university thought leadership in regional, national, and industry conversations.

Job Description

Under general supervision, performs a variety of routine professional and analytical assignments involving the practical application of management principles and techniques to routine operational activities.

The Digital Communications and Project Support Specialist supports the Department of Information Technology’s Business Operations unit through digital content development, technology communications, project documentation, and administrative support for assigned initiatives. The position prepares clear, accessible communications and maintains organized materials that support Title III Digital Transformation activities and other approved departmental projects. Working under the direction of the Director of Business Operations and in collaboration with the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator, the Specialist completes assigned communication, documentation, tracking, and logistical tasks.

Duties & Responsibilities

Digital Communications and Content Development

 Draft and update technology announcements, newsletters, website content, FAQs, service notices, and other approved communications. Translate information provided by technical and project leads into clear language for faculty, staff, students, and other stakeholders. Maintain a communications calendar for assigned projects, announcements, and departmental initiatives. Review content for accuracy, readability, accessibility, and consistency with university standards before submission for approval.

Project Documentation and Coordination Support

 Support the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator by preparing meeting materials, documenting assigned meetings, and recording decisions and action items. Maintain assigned project trackers, contact lists, documentation checklists, and shared folders using information provided by project owners. Request routine updates and missing materials as assigned and notify the Coordinator of overdue responses or incomplete documentation. Format project summaries, status reports, presentations, and closeout materials using approved content.

Title III Activity and Evidence Support

 Collect and organize supporting documentation for assigned Title III activities, including approved progress updates, communications, event materials, and evidence of completed deliverables. Maintain evidence folders and documentation checklists to support progress reporting and evaluation preparation. Prepare visual summaries and presentation materials that communicate project accomplishments and benefits. Refer questions about grant requirements, expenditures, or reporting decisions to the Activity Director or Project Coordinator.

Technology Awareness and Change Communications

 Prepare approved communications regarding technology changes, service improvements, implementation milestones, and scheduled disruptions. Develop awareness content promoting available technology services, cybersecurity practices, and university technology initiatives. Coordinate publication and distribution of approved messages through designated university channels.

Event and Stakeholder Support

 Assist with communications, registration, materials, scheduling details, and participant reminders for assigned technology events and stakeholder meetings. Compile attendance information and feedback summaries for review by the Project Coordinator. Maintain reusable communication templates and event materials.

Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

 Knowledge of digital communications, content development, and basic technical writing practices. Ability to translate technical information into clear, concise language for faculty, staff, students, and other audiences. Ability to draft, edit, proofread, and format announcements, newsletters, website content, FAQs, reports, and presentations. Knowledge of basic accessibility practices for digital content and documents. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage assigned tasks, competing deadlines, and routine follow-up. Ability to maintain accurate trackers, meeting notes, action items, documentation checklists, and shared electronic records. Ability to gather and organize information and supporting evidence for project updates, grant reporting, and evaluations. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and SharePoint, or comparable tools. Ability to use digital publishing, design, and collaboration tools to prepare professional communications and supporting materials. Ability to support meeting and event logistics, participant communications, and feedback collection. Ability to work independently on assigned responsibilities and collaboratively with the Strategic Initiatives Project Coordinator, technical staff, and university stakeholders. Ability to follow established procedures, recognize incomplete information or delays, and refer issues requiring decisions to the appropriate supervisor or project lead. Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, professionalism, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.

Minimum Training & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Communications, Public Relations, English, Journalism, Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field. 2–4 years’ experience in communications, content development, technical writing, project support, program support, or a related area. (preferably in higher education or IT). Strong writing, editing, and communication skills. Experience with content tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, MS Publisher, or similar). Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Experience must demonstrate the ability to prepare written materials, maintain organized records, use office and collaboration applications, and complete assignments within established deadlines. Higher education or public sector experience preferred.

About Nebius:


Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.


Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.


Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Please note: This role will require occasional travel to San Francisco.
The role
Nebius is looking for a DevRel Communications Designer to be a part of the Design team and embedded with DevRel. At Nebius, we believe builders decide which platforms win. AI engineers, agent builders, ML engineers and inference teams choose what to build on long before it becomes a procurement decision — and we want to earn that choice early, while they're still picking their models, inference and tooling. This role is about making Nebius the brand those builders recognize, respect, and share. 


You’re welcome to work remotely in the United States.


Your responsibilities will include: 



Building and evolving the visual language for everything developer-facing — one system that holds together across the dev.nebius.com, AI Builder Program, social, events, swag, and developer community.
Designing for where builders actually are — mostly offline: meetups, hackathons, conference presence, event environments, and swag that developers actually want to wear and keep.
Designing web pages, developer program materials, campaign visuals, and social content for a technical audience.
Making technical content look as good as it is: benchmarks, GPU specs, pricing, architecture diagrams — turning dense material into visuals people actually want to read and share.
Creating AI-templates and guidelines so the DevRel team can produce on-brand materials at speed without a designer in every loop.
Working in the open with DevRel and content: quick concepts, tight iterations, ship-learn-repeat.

We expect you to have: 



A portfolio of marketing that developers actually respect — launch pages, developer program sites, campaigns, event visuals, technical content. Engineers can smell fluff; you don't produce it.
You understand the audience: AI игшдвукы, ML engineers, DevOps, inference and platform teams, developers moving into AI. You know what catches their attention, what they ignore, and what makes them share something with a colleague.
You study the brands developers love — and can explain why their marketing lands with a technical audience, bringing that thinking into your own work.
Experience designing for physical spaces and events: booths, signage, environments, printed materials, swag — you understand print technologies, materials, and production constraints, and can take a design from concept to fabrication.
System-first mindset: a visual language that scales across surfaces, not a collection of one-offs.
AI-proficiency: up-to-date knowledge of AI tools and a strong critical eye for results — from a design expert's perspective, not an average user's.
Strong layout, composition, and information design skills: typography, grids, visual hierarchy, and the craft to keep dense technical material clear.
Ability to articulate and defend design decisions, incorporate feedback, and iterate quickly.
Excitement about defining what an AI cloud brand looks like for the people building on it.

It will be an added bonus if you have: 



Motion and video basics: animating for social, working with launch video assets.
Experience inside a developer community, DevRel program, or open-source ecosystem.
Writing/editing instincts for developer-facing copy.

Key employee benefits in the US:



Health insurance: 100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and families.
401(k) plan: Up to 4% company match with immediate vesting.
Parental leave: 20 weeks paid for primary caregivers, 12 weeks for secondary caregivers.
Remote work reimbursement: Up to $85/month for mobile and internet.
Disability & life insurance: Company-paid short-term, long-term and life insurance coverage.
Pay Transparency

$150,000 - $187,500 USD

Competitive compensation
