Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Job Overview

We''re looking for a Senior Specialist, Partner Marketing Campaigns & Events to help drive the execution of partner marketing campaigns, programs, and events that strengthen partner engagement and support business growth.

This role is ideal for a marketer who enjoys bringing campaigns and events to life, collaborating across teams, and creating meaningful experiences for partners through field marketing activities, industry events, meaningful content, and digital campaigns.

What You'll Do

Own the execution of partner marketing campaigns and programs, including field marketing activities, content initiatives, webinars, and digital campaigns.

Manage partner participation across Relativity-sponsored events and industry conferences, including sponsorship fulfillment, partner engagement, communications, event logistics, and post-event follow-up. Track and report on campaign and program performance, providing observations, insights, and recommendations to improve future partner marketing initiatives.

Create monthly and quarterly reports that provide the Partner Marketing team with visibility into campaign, program, and event performance, highlighting key results, trends, and areas for follow-up.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Events, Product Marketing, Segment Marketing, Marketing Operations, Communications, and Sales to ensure successful campaign and program execution.

5-8 years of experience in B2B marketing, preferably in tech, legal, or SaaS.

Experience working in a partner marketing, channel marketing, alliance marketing, or ecosystem marketing environment, even if not in a partner-facing capacity.

Experience supporting conferences, trade shows, customer events, sponsorships, or other field marketing activities.

Experience executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, events, or marketing programs from planning through execution and measurement.

Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs, stakeholders, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience developing marketing communications, campaign assets, or event-related content.

Comfort working with marketing performance data and campaign reporting, with the ability to identify trends and suggest opportunities for improvement.

Collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and functions.

Interest in continuing to grow into a more partner-facing partner marketing role over time, with increasing exposure to partner engagement, strategic planning, and relationship management.

partnermarketingleaderallianceschannel4c.title: Partner Marketing Leader, Alliances & Channel 4
partnermarketingleaderallianceschannel4c.description:
Stripe Marketing Leader Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses.
Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities.
Our mission isto increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.
That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.


The Partner Marketing team extends Stripe's marketing reach to customers and prospects by educating, engaging and enabling partners, globally, to build market awareness and generate demand for their Stripe solutions and services.
We recruit prospective partners and support the on-boarding and growth of existing partners as they build, launch, market, and scale business through the Stripe Partner Ecosystem and the Stripe platform.
We partner closely with our global partnerships, GTM partners, marketing, and product teams and serve many different partner types.


We're looking for an experienced, strategic, and results-oriented marketing leader to own Stripe's global partner marketing strategy for Services partnersincluding GSIsand Technology/ISV partners.
You'll lead a global team, define the multi-year operating and investment model, build influential relationships with partner and Stripe leaders, and scale programs that drive partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline, customer activation, and product adoption.
This role requires setting a clear long-term direction while leading through others and using performance insights to focus the organization on its highest-impact opportunities.


Responsibilities Set the multi-year vision and global strategy for Services, GSI, and Technology/ISV partner marketing, translating Stripe's company, marketing, and partnerships priorities into an operating model, investment strategy, and measurable outcomes.
Lead and develop a high-performing global team of four Partner Marketing professionals across APAC, AMER, and EMEA.
Establish clear accountability, build organizational capability, evolve the team as business needs change, and ensure agencies and vendors extend the team effectively.
Build trusted relationships with partner CMOs and senior Stripe leaders.
Develop joint strategies with priority partners and align global and regional teams around shared priorities, investments, and execution.
Own a portfolio of differentiated programs for strategic partners and scalable programs for the broader ecosystem.
Integrate partners into Stripe campaigns, regional initiatives, co-sell motions, events, content, and enablement to drive pipeline, activation, and product adoption.
Shape joint value propositions, messaging, and customer evidence, and turn successful programs into reusable playbooks that can scale across partners and regions.
Establish governance for market development funds and other investments, alongside the performance framework, dashboards, and business-review cadence.
Use data and financial insight to assess impact, address underperformance, and reallocate resources toward the strongest opportunities.
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role.
If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.
The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.


Minimum requirements 15+ years of relevant B2B marketing experience, including substantial experience in partner, ecosystem, channel, or alliances marketing and a strong understanding of partner business models and indirect GTM motions.
A track record of setting and leading global marketing strategy across regions, translating company priorities into long-term plans, scalable operating models, and measurable business outcomes.
Experience building, leading, and developing a distributed team of experienced marketers, including setting direction and accountability, coaching talent, and evolving organizational capabilities through change.
Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives with a high degree of autonomy, build trusted relationships with partner and internal executives, and align senior stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
Proven success delivering measurable partner-marketing outcomes and using analytical and financial judgment to manage significant budgets or market development funds, evaluate ROI, and make portfolio trade-offs.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the judgment to simplify complex issues, articulate a compelling vision, and turn strategy and performance insights into clear executive recommendations and action.
Preferred qualifications Experience developing marketing strategies for Services, GSI, Technology, or ISV partners in a global, high-growth technology environment.
Experience in payments, financial technology, enterprise software, or an adjacent industry.
Breadth across partner marketing and adjacent disciplines such as demand generation, product marketing, field marketing, or integrated campaigns.
Experience managing agencies or vendors across markets and holding them accountable for quality and results.

marketingcoordinatortucsonrubberizedcoat.description:
Company Overview


Tucson Rubberized Coatings operates in the retail and manufacturing of roof coatings.


Position Summary


The Marketing Coordinator is responsible for coordinating and executing marketing initiatives that support Tucson Rubberized Coatings' business objectives, brand strategy, product promotion, and customer engagement efforts. This position works closely with company leadership and cross-functional departments to plan, implement, and maintain marketing programs, advertising campaigns, product launches, digital marketing activities, and corporate communications.


The Marketing Coordinator serves as a central resource for marketing-related projects and is responsible for ensuring marketing materials, messaging, and branding are accurate, consistent, and aligned with company goals. This role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, effective project management, creativity, and the ability to manage multiple priorities while supporting the company's continued growth and market expansion.


Key Responsibilities



 Coordinate and execute marketing campaigns across print, digital, social media, email, and other marketing channels.
 Develop and coordinate product launch plans for new products and product enhancements.
 Assist in the creation, maintenance, and execution of the annual marketing plan.
 Create, edit, and proofread marketing materials to ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand compliance.
 Coordinate the design and production of sales collateral, brochures, flyers, signage, and promotional materials.
 Support website content updates and coordinate enhancements to improve user experience and brand visibility.
 Manage social media content calendars, create engaging content, and monitor performance metrics.
 Coordinate advertising initiatives including print, digital, outdoor, radio, and television campaigns.
 Work with external vendors, designers, printers, agencies, and media partners to ensure timely project completion.
 Maintain and organize marketing assets, graphics, photography, advertising files, and brand resources.
 Support trade shows, contractor events, customer appreciation events, and community outreach activities.
 Track marketing project timelines, budgets, and campaign performance.
 Analyze marketing data and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.
 Partner with sales and operations teams to ensure marketing efforts align with company objectives.
 Assist with internal communications and company-wide promotional initiatives.

Qualifications



 Associate or bachelor’s degree in marketing, Communications, Business, Graphic Design, or a related field preferred.
 Minimum of 2 years of marketing, advertising, communications, or related experience preferred.
 Experience coordinating multiple projects and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
 Experience with digital marketing, social media management, and content creation preferred.
 Experience in manufacturing, construction, roofing, coatings, or related industries is a plus.
 Valid driver's license and ability to travel locally for events and business needs, as required.

Skills & Competencies



 Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.
 Strong proofreading, editing, grammar, and copywriting abilities.
 Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
 Ability to prioritize competing projects and manage deadlines effectively.
 Creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
 Strong project coordination and time management capabilities.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
 Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud, including Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign preferred.
 Familiarity with website management, content management systems (CMS), and social media platforms.
 Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multiple departments.
 Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret marketing metrics and make data-driven recommendations.
 Commitment to maintaining brand standards and delivering high-quality work.

Working Conditions



 Primarily office-based environment with frequent computer and telephone use.
 Regular interaction with internal departments, customers, vendors, and contractors.
 May require occasional travel to company locations, trade shows, events, customer sites, or industry functions.
 Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use office equipment for extended periods.
 Occasionally required to lift and carry marketing materials, displays, or event supplies up to 50 pounds.
 May occasionally work outside normal business hours to support events, product launches, or special projects.

Pay: $48,000.00 - $62,000.00 per year


Work Location: In person

seniormanagerglobalpartnerecosystemmarke.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Canada, or the United Sates.

About The Team

The Senior Manager, Global Partner & Ecosystem Marketing is responsible for developing and executing global partner marketing programs that support strategic alliances and corporate growth objectives. This role works closely with partner marketing counterparts, regional field marketing teams, Product Marketing, Sales, and the Global Partner Organization to deliver integrated campaigns, partner engagement programs, and measurable pipeline impact across global markets.

What you will do

 Develop and execute the global partner marketing plans, balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution to support established business priorities, strategic partnerships, and regional growth objectives.  Manage joint go-to-market programs across consulting partners, systems integrators, hyperscalers, VARs, and strategic technology partners.  Build strong working relationships and lead through influence across Marketing, Sales, and the Global Partner organization deliver integrated go-to-market programs.  Create scalable campaign frameworks, messaging, assets, and activation toolkits that support consistent execution across regions.  Coordinate execution across regional Field Marketing, Demand Generation, ABM, Events, Communications, Customer Marketing, and Sales teams.  Manage partner planning, campaign execution, MDF investments, partner tiering activities, and marketing standards to drive consistency and scalability across the ecosystem.  Monitor and optimize program performance through dashboards, attribution, reporting, and communicate program performance, including partner-influenced pipeline, engagement metrics, and marketing effectiveness 

What we are looking for

 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.  7-10 years of progressive B2B enterprise technology marketing experience, including partner, alliance, ecosystem, field, or integrated marketing experience.  Manage team workload prioritization, goal setting, and development planning while creating an inclusive, collaborative, and accountable team environment.  Experience managing complex global marketing programs involving multiple partners, regions, and cross-functional stakeholders.  Strong understanding of the enterprise technology ecosystem and partner go-to-market models.  Experience developing integrated campaigns, executive engagement programs, thought leadership initiatives, and partner-supported demand generation programs.  Strong project management, stakeholder management, and budget management capabilities.  Excellent communication, collaboration, and influencing skills within a matrixed environment.  Experience in enterprise software, SaaS, supply chain technology, or a similarly complex B2B technology environment is preferred. 

#Senior

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)Flexible work optionsPhysical and mental well-being programsRegularly scheduled virtual fitness classesMentorship programs, training, and career developmentRecognition programs and referral rewardsHackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

Summary
  This Division administers the Perishable Agricultural Commodities Act (PACA), which prohibits unfair trade practices in the marketing of fresh and frozen fruits and vegetables in interstate or foreign commerce and the Produce Agency Act (PAA). The position is located in a regional office of the division.


  Learn more about this agency

    The public

  Duties

 Qualifications

FOR THE GS-07 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-05 grade level) that demonstrates:


 
  Reviewing technical documents against program standards.
  Utilizing written documentation and computer databases to prepare reports and case file information.
  Ability to interpret grading procedures and U.S. grade standards for a commodity.
 OR
 

 

  1 full year of graduate level education in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  Superior Academic Achievement: To qualify based on superior academic achievement, you must have completed the requirements for a bachelor's degree from an accredited institution AND 1) have a class standing in the upper third of the graduating class, 2) membership in a national scholastic honor society (excluding Freshman honor societies), or 3) must meet certain GPA requirements. GPA requirements: 3.0 or higher out of a possible 4.0 as recorded on official transcripts or as computed based on 4 years of education, or courses completed during the final 2 year of the curriculum; OR 3.5 or higher out of a possible 4.0 based on the average of the required course completed in the major field or courses completed during the final 2 years of the curriculum (GPA will be rounded to one decimal place, e.g., 2.95 rounds to 3.0 and 2.94 rounds to 2.9). 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
FOR THE GS-09 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-07 level) that may have been obtained in the private or public (local, county, state, Federal) sectors which demonstrates: 
 
  Researching laws relating to business structures, bankruptcy, and state regulatory functions.
  Collecting evidence and developing findings of investigations under license, complaint, disciplinary, and trust provisions.
  Analyzing evidence and developing findings and recommendations resulting from investigations involving licensing, complaint, disciplinary, and trust provisions.
 OR
 

 

  Master's or equivalent graduate degree in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  2 full years of progressively higher level graduate education leading to such a degree. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  LL.B. or J.D., if related. 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
FOR THE GS-11 LEVEL: Applicants must have one year of specialized experience (equivalent to the GS-09 level) that may have been obtained in the private or public (local, county, state, Federal) sectors which demonstrates: 
 
  Applying business procedures, laws, and regulations, relating to business structures, bankruptcy, and state regulatory functions.
  Developing regulatory documents to describe, justify, and establish legal requirements.
  Reviewing, researching, and analyzing industry proposals, economic, or business data.
 OR
 

 

  Ph.D. or equivalent doctoral degree in a field of study directly related to the work of this position as described in the vacancy announcement. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  3 full years of progressively higher-level graduate education leading to such a degree. 
 

 
OR
 

 

  LL.M., if related 
 

 

  Equivalent combinations of education and experience are qualifying for this grade level. 
 

 
TRANSCRIPTS are required if: 
 
  You are qualifying for the position based on education.
  You are qualifying for this position based on a combination of experience and education.
  You are qualifying for this position based on Superior Academic Achievement.
  This education must have been successfully completed and obtained from an accredited school, college, or university.
 COMBINATION OF EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE AT THE GS-7/9/11 GRADE LEVEL: Applicants may have combinations of successfully completed education and specialized experience to meet total qualification requirements. The total percentages must equal at least 100 percent to qualify for that grade level. 
 

 

  Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., Peace Corps, AmeriCorps) and other organizations (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment. You will receive credit for all qualifying experience, including volunteer experience. 
 


 
  Education

  Additional information

corporatemarketingdirectorcapitalequipme.title: Corporate Marketing Director - Capital Equipment
corporatemarketingdirectorcapitalequipme.description:
We are working with a publicly traded capital equipment and technology organization in Tempe that is looking for a Corporate Marketing Director.




This is a broad, hands-on marketing leadership role for someone who understands complex technical products, engineering-driven customers, and B2B capital equipment markets. The Director will work closely with the CEO, business-unit leaders, sales, engineering, and other stakeholders to strengthen the company’s overall market position and create a more consistent story across multiple products and businesses.




This is an individual-contributor role today. The right person needs to be comfortable setting the strategy, influencing senior leaders, and personally driving the work.




What You’ll Do

Develop and strengthen the company’s overall positioning, messaging, and corporate brand.Partner with business-unit leaders, sales, and technical teams to develop product and portfolio positioning.Translate complex product features and technical capabilities into clear customer benefits and value propositions.Bring multiple product lines and business units together under a consistent company story.Develop messaging and materials for customers, executives, industry events, presentations, and other external audiences.Support go-to-market strategy, product launches, sales enablement, competitive intelligence, and market research.Own and improve corporate marketing materials, website messaging, presentations, collateral, and brand standards.Support trade shows and industry events, including development of messaging, presentations, and supporting materials.Partner with outside resources supporting investor relations, communications, design, and other marketing initiatives.Work directly with senior leadership and influence stakeholders across the organization without relying on direct authority.


What We’re Looking For

10+ years of progressive experience in product marketing, strategic marketing, technical marketing, or marketing communications within a technical B2B environment.Strong preference for experience in semiconductor equipment, semiconductor materials, capital equipment, advanced manufacturing, industrial technology, electronics, scientific instrumentation, or related technical markets.Ability to understand technical products and comfortably work with engineers, sales leaders, product experts, and technical customers.Experience developing product positioning, value propositions, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.Strong understanding of how technical B2B customers evaluate products and make purchasing decisions.Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge existing thinking, and drive organizational change.Strong executive presence, communication skills, and storytelling ability.Comfortable operating as a hands-on individual contributor in a lean organization.Bachelor’s degree required. An engineering, technical, business, or related degree is strongly preferred.Experience in semiconductor or capital equipment markets is highly preferred.


The Environment

This is not a traditional large-company marketing role with highly specialized teams supporting every function. The Director will have significant ownership and visibility and will work across the organization to gather information, develop recommendations, and drive execution.

The ideal person is someone who understands technical markets, is naturally curious, can earn credibility with engineers and commercial leaders, and has the conviction to challenge existing approaches when there is a better way to position the company.

communicationsmarketingspecialistwingbud.description:
Primary Function


WingBud is seeking a Social Media & Marketing Specialist to lead our social media presence and support marketing initiatives that grow our brand and community. In this role, you'll help expand WingBud's visibility and audience engagement while also supporting our mission of helping clients build stronger communication, networking, and social skills. This position is ideal for a student interested in gaining hands-on experience in digital marketing, content strategy, and community building within a growing organization.


Specific Job Duties & Responsibilities



Create, schedule, and manage content across social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn) to build brand awareness and drive engagement
Plan and execute marketing and outreach campaigns, including promoting events and growing WingBud's audience
Develop creative content (graphics, captions, short-form video, etc.) aligned with WingBud's brand voice
Track and analyze engagement metrics (reach, follower growth, post performance, event attendance) and provide data-driven recommendations for improvement
Collaborate with the team on brainstorming and executing new marketing strategies
Support and occasionally co-facilitate one-on-one and small-group client sessions focused on communication confidence, public speaking, and social engagement
Serve as a role model for professionalism, communication excellence, and inclusive social dynamics across all WingBud programming

Qualifications



Strong understanding of social media platforms, trends, and content creation best practices
Experience with or strong interest in digital marketing (paid or organic)
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Reliable, energetic, adaptable, and professional demeanor
Comfortable working both independently and collaboratively in a small-team environment
Bonus: experience in graphic design, video editing, event planning, or mentorship

Educational Preferences/Requirements



Currently enrolled as a college student (any year/major considered; marketing, communications, or related fields preferred)

marketingmanagercorporaterpmliving.title: Marketing Manager-Corporate
marketingmanagercorporaterpmliving.description:
About the position

The Corporate Marketing Manager is a key stakeholder in developing RPM Living’s corporate marketing strategy and manages corporate marketing projects, programs, and activities. The role contributes to the corporate brand narrative and marketing strategy and support for operational specialties, with the goal of increasing brand awareness and strengthening RPM’s position as an industry leader. It calls for strong account and project management, strategic thinking, and the ability to align cross-functional teams.\n\nThe manager leads corporate marketing initiatives, plans and executes campaigns, coordinates project resources and stakeholders, and collaborates with creative and communications teams on internal branding and communication. The role also manages cross-functional workflows, provides marketing strategy and recommendations, communicates campaign plans and results, and resolves prioritization issues. It evaluates corporate marketing performance and return on investment, and partners with board members, executive leadership, operations, and vendors to align marketing work with company standards, vision, and organizational priorities. This is a hybrid position requiring work in a corporate or regional office four days per week. Travel is less than 30%.

Responsibilities

Lead corporate marketing initiatives that support business objectives and serve as the client-facing lead for assigned internal and external stakeholders.Plan and execute campaign strategies, plans, and tactics for internal and external initiatives; monitor and communicate project details and ensure work is completed on time and to a high standard.Partner with creative and communications teams on internal branding and communications that support change management, align with company vision, and engage associates.Collaborate with creative services, communications, and other teams to develop and deliver project resources.Promote a consistent customer experience across internal departments, regions, and clients in marketing support.Manage cross-functional projects from planning through completion, including scope, budgets, schedules, resources, assets, deliverables, workflow, and conflict resolution.Manage daily workflow and project priorities across multiple departments.Review ad hoc requests and content from internal departments and business leaders, and provide relevant marketing and communications strategy or recommendations.Communicate and present campaign information, deadlines, release dates, and results to internal and external stakeholders.Lead regular internal meetings for corporate marketing projects and communicate expectations.Troubleshoot project or campaign prioritization conflicts and elevate issues when needed.Collect performance data, ROI results, and anecdotal feedback to prepare actionable post-campaign evaluations and reporting.Build and maintain partnerships with board members, executive leadership, operations, and vendor partners to ensure company standards and vision are consistently represented.Work with senior leadership to align organizational priorities and stakeholder objectives, producing alignment documents and creative briefs.Research and recommend new marketing opportunities and channels.Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.At least 2 years of experience in a marketing-related field.Proven track record of success in developing and executing enterprise communications strategies.Ability to travel less than 30%.Nice-to-haves

Experience in the multifamily housing industry.Valid driver’s license preferred.Benefits

Comprehensive healthcare coverage for full-time, regular associates.Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs.Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance.401(k) with company match.Professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans.Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging programs and Employee Resource Groups.Paid time off, floating holidays, and volunteer days.Discounts on Costco membership, movie tickets, health and wellness, entertainment, and travel.Weekly pay for associates working onsite at an apartment community.

marketingexecutivemarketvaluesouthwest.title: Marketing Executive
marketingexecutivemarketvaluesouthwest.description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Marketing Executive to support the delivery of in-person promotional campaigns, increase brand visibility, and engage directly with prospective customers. This is a junior-level, hands-on marketing position focused on representing products and services, communicating promotional messages, and contributing to daily customer acquisition initiatives.


The ideal candidate is outgoing, adaptable, and eager to develop practical marketing experience. No previous marketing experience is required, as training will be provided. This position offers an opportunity to build communication, presentation, and campaign execution skills while working alongside an experienced team in a customer-facing environment.


Primary Responsibilities


• Participate in the execution of daily in-person marketing and promotional campaigns.
• Represent assigned brands, products, and services during customer-facing activities.
• Introduce promotional offerings to prospective customers through direct conversations.
• Communicate key marketing messages clearly and consistently.
• Increase brand awareness by providing accurate and engaging product information.
• Identify customer interests and tailor promotional conversations accordingly.
• Explain product features, service benefits, and available promotional options.
• Support customer acquisition initiatives through professional face-to-face engagement.
• Deliver basic product presentations and demonstrations when applicable.
• Answer customer questions regarding products, services, and current campaigns.
• Assist interested customers with understanding available options and next steps.
• Maintain familiarity with assigned brands, product updates, and campaign objectives.
• Support the preparation and distribution of approved promotional materials.
• Assist with organizing marketing displays and customer engagement areas.
• Observe customer responses and communicate relevant feedback to team members.
• Contribute to daily campaign activity and customer engagement goals.
• Assist with recording promotional results and customer interactions when required.
• Collaborate with colleagues to maintain consistent brand messaging.
• Participate in campaign briefings, product training, and team discussions.
• Follow established promotional procedures and company representation standards.
• Adapt communication approaches based on customer questions and interests.
• Support additional marketing and customer engagement activities as assigned.




Requirements

• High school diploma or equivalent required.
• Previous experience in marketing, promotions, sales, retail, hospitality, or customer service preferred but not required.
• Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
• Friendly, confident, and professional approach to customer interactions.
• Comfortable initiating conversations with new people.
• Ability to communicate product information and promotional messaging clearly.
• Strong listening skills and interest in understanding customer needs.
• Positive attitude and willingness to learn new marketing techniques.
• Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to adapt to different customer interactions and daily priorities.
• Self-motivated with a dependable work ethic.
• Comfortable participating in product presentations and promotional activities.
• Ability to work toward established individual and team objectives.
• Strong teamwork and willingness to accept coaching and feedback.
• Interest in developing practical experience in marketing and brand representation.




Benefits

• Comprehensive onboarding and campaign-specific training.
• Supportive and collaborative team environment.
• Hands-on experience in promotional marketing and brand representation.
• Ongoing training in product knowledge, communication, and customer engagement.
• Regular team activities and company events.
• Employee recognition initiatives.

seniorcommunicationsspecialisttailscale.description:
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications.


We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are.
From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more.
We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be.
We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function.
This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.

Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure.
We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure.
We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO.
You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.

Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage.
It could also include research-led PR.

Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.

Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.

Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.

Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence.
Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.

Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.

Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation.
Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement.
Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.

10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.

~ Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.

~ Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.

~ Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.

~ Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.

~ Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.

~ Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement.

~ A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.


Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.

Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.

Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.

Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.

mediarelationsspecialistatbigvoicecommun.description:
ABOUT BIG VOICE COMMUNICATIONS

Big Voice Communications is a women-owned strategic communications and public relations firm in New Haven, Connecticut. We are a small, strategic team that punches above its weight for a national roster of nonprofits. Since 2005, we have helped clients earn attention for the work that matters to them, from health and education to public safety and the arts. If you like variety, real ownership of your work, and colleagues who care about doing it well, you will fit in here.



Are you ready to apply Make sure you understand all the responsibilities and tasks associated with this role before proceeding.


THE ROLE

Reports to: Principal / Account Director

Employment type: Full-time, exempt

Location: New Haven, Connecticut area (in a small-office environment; flexible hours considered)




Our Media Relations Specialist partners with account and client leaders to build media and influencer strategies that earn coverage for our clients. This person is a capable communications professional who develops sharp pitches and press materials, exercises sound judgment across a wide range of tasks, and brings a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage across a wide variety of channels for a wide variety of clients. Success in this role means continually being creative to turn client expertise into earned media that reaches the right audiences.




Please note: This is an earned media role. Candidates must demonstrate a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage in a wide variety of channels -- print, broadcast, online, trade and podcast -- for a wide variety of clients. Experience limited to social media or to working as a journalist does not meet this requirement.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Identify and create opportunities to place client stories across traditional, digital, and influencer channels

• Continually bring fresh story ideas to the team 

• Write and pitch stories that showcase our clients' thought leadership

• Develop compelling, media-ready content including press releases, op-eds, bylines, pitches, media advisories and messaging

• Identify vertical pitching opportunities for clients in trade publications, national and regional media as well as bloggers, influencers and podcast hosts

• Track and foster relationships with beat reporters who cover niche topics relevant to client portfolios

• Recommend and track earned media efforts

• Coordinate and monitor interviews and prepare clients

• Monitor the news daily to surface timely opportunities for clients

• Participate in client meetings and contribute to strategic planning

• Collaborate across multiple client teams and pivot quickly as priorities shift




REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor's degree, preferably in communications, English or journalism

• Two to four years of related experience in public relations, media relations or communications

• Must demonstrate a solid track record of pitching and earning media coverage in a wide variety of channels (print, broadcast, online, trade and podcast) for a wide variety of clients

• A strong portfolio of earned media placements you secured for multiple clients

• Social media experience alone or journalism experience alone does not qualify

• Excellent writing and editing skills with a creative, engaging voice

• Working knowledge of earned media, including building media lists and plans

• Strong presentation skills and the confidence to offer sound counsel to clients

• Ability to organize and manage multiple projects at once

• Meticulous attention to detail

• Ability to work independently and as part of a team

• Stays informed of new and emerging channels and tools that secure earned media

• Resourceful, effective problem-solving skills

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and media relations tools such as Cision

• Comfort using social media platforms including LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram and X




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Familiarity with media monitoring and analytics tools

• General knowledge of photography, video or audio editing

• Bilingual is a bonus!




COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

Big Voice Communications offers a competitive salary commensurate with experience, along with benefits such as health and dental coverage, paid time off, 401K and flexible scheduling. 




WORK HOURS AND TRAVEL

Hours: Full-time. In-office

Travel: Limited travel two to four times a year.




TO APPLY

Please send a resume, cover letter to  . Please include your full name in the file name of each document.




Big Voice Communications believes in creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion. We strive to recruit a diverse group of candidates to help us achieve that goal. Big Voice Communications is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, age, national origin, citizenship status, marital status, disability status, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.

About the position

Banana Republic is seeking a dynamic, experienced Manager to support and continuously develop and optimize its CRM and retention strategies. This data-driven, customer-focused role is part of the CRM Retention marketing team, which works to understand customer behaviors that drive long-term value, loyalty, and engagement, and to identify opportunities for personalization across the customer lifecycle.\n\nThe Manager owns the lifecycle roadmap and triggered-program portfolio across Email, SMS, and Push for Banana Republic Specialty and Factory. The role prioritizes high-value customer moments, coordinates lifecycle programs across channels, and partners with batch-communications teams to ensure customers receive appropriate messages. It also owns program-level reporting, performance diagnosis, test planning and recommendations, and contributes to customer-level contact strategy and personalization.\n\nThe position executes program builds, launches, and quality assurance in partnership with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, technology, and vendor partners. It also manages the retention Direct Mail program end to end, from audience selection and creative briefing through execution and measurement of incrementality and ROI.

Responsibilities

Own the lifecycle roadmap and triggered-program portfolio across Email, SMS, and Push, including behavioral triggers, post-purchase and order communications, low-in-stock messaging, and loyalty programs across Banana Republic Specialty and Factory.Prioritize high-value customer moments and decide which programs to build, scale, fix, or stop.Coordinate lifecycle programs across Email, SMS, and Push, and partner with batch-communications teams so communications complement one another.Own program-level performance reporting; diagnose year-over-year and week-over-week changes and distinguish efficiency gains from mix shifts, volume effects, attributed demand, and incremental demand.Reconcile data across sources and validate figures before sharing them with leadership.Translate performance results into clear business implications for senior leaders, including what happened, why it matters, and recommended actions.Build and run a testing agenda focused on incrementality, customer-message fit, and productive communication volume; interpret results and recommend whether to scale, modify, or stop programs.Help shape customer-level communication decisions when customers qualify for multiple messages, evaluating demand, engagement, and file health together.Partner with analytics and CRM teams to deepen personalization where it creates measurable value.Manage program builds, launches, and quality assurance end to end with Digital Production, Brand and Content, Analytics, and technology and vendor partners.Manage timelines, hold partners accountable, and escalate issues early with a recommendation.Manage the retention Direct Mail program end to end, including audience selection, creative briefing, execution, and measurement of incrementality and ROI.Requirements

acquisitionmarketingmanagerclientsblackb.description:
Clients Blackbox is a performance marketing agency specializing in Meta advertising for Registered Investment Advisors.


 We help financial advisors grow their practices by generating qualified appointments with high-net-worth prospects. Our proven video sales letter methodology has generated more than $45 billion in AUM pipeline for financial advisors across the country.


 We operate with a performance-first mindset. Our clients hire us to deliver qualified appointments at a specific cost per appointment, with target show rates and close rates that make the economics work for their practice. Clients Blackbox is in a major growth period, and we're looking for a Paid Media Strategist / Account Strategist who can own client accounts from strategy through execution.


  The Opportunity
 This is a hands-on strategist role with responsibility for both client relationships and campaign performance. You'll own a portfolio of accounts, lead bi-weekly client calls, manage Meta campaigns, monitor results, contribute to ad messaging, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients.


 You'll report to the Associate Director of Operations and be directly accountable for client results, relationships, and retention.


  What You'll Own
  Client Strategy & Relationships


 
  Own a portfolio of client accounts and serve as the primary point of contact
  Lead bi-weekly client calls covering performance, strategy, priorities, and next steps
  Prepare and send bi-weekly performance reports at least 24 hours before scheduled calls
  Translate campaign data into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical clients
  Build strong client relationships that support retention, renewals, and referrals
  Solve account issues proactively to support stability and growth
 
  Meta Campaign Management


 
  Build, launch, and optimize Meta campaigns focused on lead generation and appointment booking
  Manage budgets, audience targeting, bid strategies, creative testing, and campaign variables
  Monitor performance daily and make adjustments based on cost-per-appointment and other key metrics
  Diagnose underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve results
  Test audiences, messaging, and creative to identify opportunities for stronger performance
  Contribute to ad copy and campaign messaging
 
  Tracking & Technical Execution


 
  Set up and troubleshoot tracking, Meta pixels, and conversion events
  Configure Calendly integrations, Zapier automations, and lead-routing workflows
  Resolve technical issues between advertising platforms and client systems
  Proactively monitor tracking and lead flow to prevent issues from affecting client results
 
 
 Requirements
 

 


 
  4+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with a strong focus on Meta advertising
  Experience simultaneously managing multiple client accounts and leading client-facing conversations
  Proven ability to manage campaigns toward defined performance targets while supporting client retention
  Experience with conversion tracking, pixels, and basic marketing automation
  Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills
 
  Preferred Experience


 
  Financial services marketing
  Lead-generation and appointment-setting campaigns
  Video sales letter marketing
  High-ticket or considered-purchase funnels
  Direct-response advertising
 
  How You Work
 You take ownership. When something isn't working, you investigate the issue, determine what needs to change, and act. You're comfortable being accountable for results and explaining performance clearly to clients who may not speak marketing.


 You're organized, detail-oriented, and able to move quickly across multiple accounts without losing sight of the outcome. You want to be responsible for making the account work - not one of several people sharing responsibility for it.



   Benefits
 

 


 
  Paid Time Off, including vacation, sick time, and public holidays
  Training & Development
  Work From Home
  Flexible Schedule
  Performance Bonus

At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. All team members receive a competitive base salary and compensation package - this is Total Rewards. Employees enjoy multiple wealth-building opportunities through our annual stock grant, employee stock purchase plan, 401(k), and access to free, year-round money coaches. That’s how we’re UNSTOPPABLE for our employees!

Field marketing teams move fast — but only as fast as their infrastructure allows. The Marketing Operations & Field Programs Manager is the person who builds and maintains that infrastructure. This role owns the vendor ecosystem that supports field execution: identifying the right partners, running a rigorous onboarding process, managing procurement relationships, and holding vendors to clear performance and compliance standards over time. When a Market Activation Manager needs a local canvassing partner, a print fulfillment vendor, or a promotional materials supplier, this role is why a qualified, contracted option already exists — rather than requiring a ground-up sourcing process every time.

Beyond vendor management, this role owns the operational capabilities that make the field team more effective at scale: the creative asset repository that gives every market consistent, brand-compliant materials; the swag and collateral ordering tools that remove friction from local activations; and the operational processes that keep field programs running cleanly across a distributed, high-volume team. This is an enablement role — its measure of success is how smoothly the field executes, not how visible the work behind it is.

Working Conditions

— Travel required: This is a remote role with occasional travel for vendor site visits, field team onboarding, or program activations.

— Cross-functional coordination with procurement, legal, finance, and the broader Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team.

— Operational pace is steady-state with periodic intensity around vendor onboarding, new campaign launches, and/or capability rollouts.


Job Responsibilities

Vendor Management & Onboarding

— Vendor Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end process for identifying, evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors that support field marketing execution — including canvassing partners, event staffing agencies, print and fulfillment vendors, promotional merchandise suppliers, and local media partners.

— Onboarding Standards: Develop and maintain clear criteria for why a vendor gets brought on: capability fit, geographic coverage, pricing benchmarks, compliance requirements, diversity and inclusion considerations, and track record. Document those standards so decisions are defensible and repeatable.

— Vendor Performance: Manage active vendor relationships — conduct regular performance reviews, track SLA compliance, resolve issues before they become field disruptions, and make recommendations on continuation, expansion, or termination.

— Procurement Partnership: Serve as the primary liaison between the field marketing team and T-Mobile's procurement function — managing SOWs, POs, and contract renewals in partnership with legal and procurement, and keeping field leaders informed on vendor status and timelines.

— Vendor Registry: Maintain a vendor registry that gives the field team a clear, current view of approved partners by category and geography — so MAMs and Regional Field Leads aren't sourcing ad hoc.

Field Capabilities & Tools

— Creative Repository: Own the creative asset repository — the centralized library where field teams access brand-approved templates, campaign materials, photography, copy guides, and customizable collateral. Keep it current, organized, and actually usable.

— Swag & Collateral Tools: Manage swag and promotional merchandise ordering systems — from vendor selection to ordering platform configuration to fulfillment tracking. The field team should be able to order what they need without a manual workaround.

— Capability Development: Identify operational friction points in how the field team accesses tools, materials, and vendor support — and build the processes or systems to remove them. This includes onboarding new MAMs and Regional Field Leads to available capabilities.

— Scaling Support: Partner with the broader Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team to scope and implement new operational capabilities as the field program scales — evaluating new tools, platforms, and vendor categories as needs evolve.

Budget Management

— Team Budget Ownership: Own the Field Marketing Strategy & Operations team budget — managing total spend across vendor contracts, field programs, creative production, tools, and collateral against plan.

— Budget Tracking: Build and maintain a monthly budget tracker with visibility into committed spend, forecasted spend, and remaining budget by category — giving the Sr. Manager and broader leadership team a clear, current picture at all times.

— Finance Partnership: Partner with finance on budget cycles, reforecasts, and end-of-quarter reconciliations. Flag variances early with a clear explanation and a recommended path forward — not a surprise at month-end.

— Vendor Spend Management: Manage vendor spend against contracted SOWs — tracking invoices, approving POs, and ensuring the team operates within budget without sacrificing field readiness.

Process & Compliance

— SOPs: Establish and document standard operating procedures for how the field team engages vendors, orders materials, manages field program budgets, and reports spend — reducing inconsistency across markets.

— Policy Compliance: Ensure all vendor relationships and field program expenditures comply with T-Mobile procurement policies, brand standards, and any applicable regulatory requirements — and that the field team has the guidance they need to stay compliant.


Qualifications

— Bachelor's Degree plus 3 years of related work experience. Or, advanced degree with 1 year of related work experience. Or, combination of education and experience deemed equivalent

— 4+ years in marketing operations, vendor management, field programs, or a related role with direct responsibility for procurement partnerships and operational process design.

— Experience managing vendor relationships end-to-end — from sourcing and onboarding through contract management and performance review.

— Demonstrated ability to build and maintain operational processes in a distributed or field-based environment.

— Comfortable navigating corporate procurement processes — SOWs, POs, vendor compliance requirements — and translating those requirements for field-facing teams.

— Strong organizational and project management skills; able to manage multiple vendor relationships and operational workstreams simultaneously.

— Experience in telecom, broadband, or a consumer business with a field sales or local marketing component preferred.

— Familiarity with creative asset management platforms, swag/merchandise ordering tools, or field enablement systems preferred.

— Background in field marketing, event marketing, or brand activation — understands what field teams actually need operationally preferred.

— Experience working with legal and procurement on vendor contracts and compliance documentation preferred.

— At least 18 years of age

— Legally authorized to work in the United States

communicationssystemsengineeropticalquan.description:
Description 
 SAIC is seeking a Communications Systems Engineer with strong optical and quantum communications engineering experience to support specialized analysis, engineering, design, and operations for Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of War (DoW) customers. We support development of next-generation and far-future national security systems across land, sea, air, and space domains.
  We are hiring a Communications Systems Engineer to provide systems engineering and technical advisory (SETA) support to an IC Research & Development (R&D) customer developing advanced hardware, software, and architectural solutions for mission-critical optical and quantum communication systems. 
  Responsibilities 
 • Perform technical reviews, assessments, and risk evaluations of optical and quantum communication system development efforts at the component, subsystem, system, and architecture levels. 
 • Evaluate designs and technologies including optical terminals, free-space optical links, photonic components, entanglement-based communication architectures, and quantum-enhanced optical subsystems. 
 • Assess emerging technologies and identify gaps related to high-bandwidth space links, advanced modulation formats, pointing/tracking systems, link budgets, networking performance, and secure quantum-enabled transport architectures. 
 • Support development of technology roadmaps, requirements, specifications, verification approaches, and transition strategies for optical and quantum system modernization. 
 • Conduct technical outreach with mission users to capture needs and evaluate applicability of emerging optical and quantum capabilities. 
 • Prepare system engineering documentation, technical analyses, and program-level briefings to communicate findings and strategic recommendations. 
 • Provide support to programmatic and acquisition activities, including source selections, lifecycle documentation, and system integration planning. 
  
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications 
• Bachelor's degree in engineering, physics, or related discipline and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience
• Experience with USG program management and acquisition lifecycle processes and documentation.
• Strong interpersonal, verbal, and technical writing communication skills.
• Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.
Desired Qualifications 
• Master's degree in engineering, physics, or related discipline.
• 12+ years of relevant experience, including at least 4 years in optical or quantum communication systems.
• 1+ year of experience supporting USG R&D acquisition processes and documentation.
• Experience with space-based optical terminals, quantum optical payloads, photonic systems, or advanced quantum-enhanced communication architectures
 
  
 Target salary range: $160,001 - $200,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

eventsmarketingcoordinatorarrivia.description:
We're looking for an organized, proactive Events & Marketing Coordinator to bring consumer travel events to life and support the marketing that keeps customers connected. If you enjoy coordinating people, managing details, and seeing a plan come together onsite, this role offers hands-on ownership with room to grow.




This is an onsite position based in Tucson, Arizona, with local travel required for events.



About the Role




Events are the primary focus, from a large annual travel show to smaller supplier presentations and online webinars. You will coordinate free, consumer-facing events that bring multiple travel suppliers together, managing the details from planning and promotion through setup, execution, and follow-up.




Between seasonal event peaks, you will support marketing campaigns and social media activity. This combined role is ideal for someone with practical event coordination experience or an early-career candidate who has managed meaningful events through internships, hospitality, campus organizations, or community activities.



What You'll Own







 Event Planning: Coordinate consumer travel shows, supplier presentations, and smaller events, keeping timelines, task lists, and communications organized.
 Supplier and Venue Coordination: Work with travel suppliers, venues, vendors, and internal teams to bring multiple participants together for a well-run event.
 Onsite Execution: Handle setup, registration, signage, materials, onsite coordination, and breakdown, helping guests and suppliers have a positive experience.
 Supplier Webinars: Coordinate online events, including scheduling, promotional materials, participant communications, and follow-up.
 Event Promotion: Support invitations, email communications, and promotional content that encourage attendance at our free events.
 Results and Follow-Up: Track attendance, expenses, and event outcomes, and keep post-event communications and next steps moving.
 Marketing Support: Help coordinate campaigns, creative assets, approvals, and deadlines across email, web, print, and other channels.
 Social Media: Create and schedule event-related and brand content for LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube, and monitor engagement.
 Quality and Organization: Proofread materials, check details, and maintain calendars so marketing work and event deadlines stay on track.




What You'll Bring





 Event planning or coordination experience, whether gained professionally, through internships, or through substantial campus or community involvement.
 Strong organization and follow-through, with the ability to manage several deadlines and changing priorities.
 Clear, professional communication with suppliers, vendors, customers, and colleagues.
 A dependable, hands-on approach. You are comfortable handling both the planning and the practical work that makes an event successful.
 Some familiarity with marketing and social media. Broader campaign experience is a plus, but event coordination is the priority.
 Attention to detail and confidence proofreading customer-facing materials.
 Comfort using everyday business software and learning new marketing, webinar, and social media tools.
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business, Hospitality, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
 Reliable transportation for local event travel, including Tucson, Green Valley, Oro Valley, and occasional Phoenix-area events.
 Availability to occasionally work outside standard business hours for events.
 Ability to lift, carry, or move event materials and boxes weighing up to 30 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.




Who We Are



arrivia powers travel loyalty and rewards programs for some of the world's leading brands. We connect travelers with memorable experiences through the technology, supplier relationships, and service that support our partners.




Bon Voyage Travel is proud to be part of the arrivia family of brands. Together, we connect travelers with exceptional vacation experiences, including cruises, resorts, and tour packages.



Our Core Values
