Content and Digital Campaign Manager at Hexagon Mining, Inc. (Tucson, AZ Headquarters)

Your browser cookies must be enabled in order to apply for this job. Please contact support@jobscore.com if you need further instruction on how to do that.

Content and Digital Campaign Manager

MARKETING COMMUNICATIONS | Tucson, AZ Headquarters | Full Time | Opened 28 days ago

Job Description

Hexagon's Mining division is seeking a Content and Digital Campaign Manager to develop compelling content and lead digital campaigns that engage audiences, generate demand, and support global business priorities.

This is a hands-on role with equal responsibility for content strategy and creation (50%) and digital campaign management (50%). You will turn complex ideas, customer challenges, and technology into clear, engaging narratives, while planning, executing, and optimising targeted digital campaigns. Both disciplines are core to the role: creating relevant content and ensuring it reaches the right audiences to strengthen our brand, engage customers, and generate demand.

Your content remit spans video, digital and social formats, with a strong emphasis on visual storytelling, from story development and scripting through filming, editing, and distribution. Your campaign remit spans audience targeting, channel planning, campaign delivery, lead nurturing, testing, and performance optimisation. Across both, you will align audience needs, the customer journey, and business objectives to create content that drives engagement and conversion.

You will work with global customers and partners, collaborating with the brand & comms team, regional marketing and product marketing, to align content and digital campaigns with business priorities.

You will have considerable autonomy to identify content opportunities, develop ideas, and manage content projects and digital campaigns from brief and production through launch, measurement, and ongoing optimisation.

Job responsibilities

Content strategy and creation - 50%

Support the development and execution of content strategies aligned with marketing, communications, product, campaign, and business priorities.Identify strong stories and translate complex technical and business subjects into clear, audience-focused content.Develop content across multiple formats and channels, including video, customer stories, articles, campaign content, product marketing materials, social media, and digital platforms.Lead video projects from concept to delivery, including research, story development, scripting and storyboarding, filming, editing, distribution, and measurement.Work directly with customers, subject-matter experts, product managers, sales teams, executives, and marketing colleagues to uncover insights and develop credible, relevant stories.Apply strong copywriting and editorial judgement to ensure content is concise, engaging, accurate, and appropriate for its intended audience.Ensure content aligns with Hexagon''s brand identity, messaging, product positioning, and tone of voice.Identify opportunities to repurpose, adapt, and optimise existing content across channels and audiences, prioritising quality and relevance over volume.Use content and campaign performance data to understand audience engagement, assess effectiveness, and recommend improvements.Manage multiple content projects simultaneously, from initial brief through stakeholder review, production, publication, and measurement.Manage external agencies, freelancers, and production partners when specialist skills or additional capacity are required.Contribute ideas and recommendations that help evolve Hexagon Mining''s content and video strategy.Digital campaign management - 50%

Plan, execute, and optimise integrated digital campaigns aligned with business priorities, working with regional marketing to define target audiences, objectives, channel plans, timelines, and success measures.Manage campaign delivery across email, web, paid digital, and social channels, coordinating internal specialists and external partners to ensure timely execution and a consistent customer experience.Develop campaign messaging, content, landing pages, and calls to action that connect audience needs with clear next steps across the customer journey.Manage our CRM and Marketing Automation platform to support audience segmentation, lead capture, nurture programmes, and timely lead handover and follow-up.Monitor campaign performance against agreed engagement, conversion, and demand-generation measures; test messaging, creative, and landing pages, and translate results into practical improvements.Track spend and results, and recommend adjustments to improve campaign efficiency and effectiveness.Knowledge and Experience - Required:

8+ years of professional marketing experience, with demonstrated hands-on capability in both content strategy and creation and digital campaign management, preferably within a B2B, technology, industrial, engineering, or similarly complex environment.A Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.Portfolio demonstrating both high-quality content, including video production and editing, and digital campaigns, with clear examples of campaign objectives, execution, optimisation, and measurable results.Strong storytelling and copywriting skills, with the ability to find the human and business story within complex or technical subject matter.Experience working in mining, technology, industrial, engineering, or another complex B2B environment.Demonstrated experience developing content and independently planning, executing, and optimising integrated digital campaigns across email, web, paid digital, and social channels.Practical video production experience, including storyboarding, scripting, filming, and editing.Proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro or comparable professional editing software, with the ability to adapt to Premiere Pro.Practical experience with marketing automation, email campaign platforms, website or landing-page tools, and CRM systems to support segmentation, lead capture, nurture programmes, and lead handover.Ability to interpret campaign analytics, track engagement and conversion, conduct A/B testing, and translate findings into improvements to messaging, targeting, creative, and landing pages.Strong project management skills, with the ability to balance content production and campaign delivery, coordinate stakeholders and specialist partners, and manage schedules, spend, and reporting.Knowledge and Experience - Desired:

Experience creating content in collaboration with customers and turning customer experiences into compelling stories.Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or production vendors across different markets.Experience with Adobe Creative Cloud beyond Premiere Pro, including tools such as After Effects, Photoshop, or Audition.Photography and on-location video production experience.Experience using marketing and customer data to understand customer behaviour, identify audience or content insights, and inform content strategy and decision-making.Experience analysing content performance and translating data into practical recommendations for future content and campaigns.Spanish or Portuguese language skills alongside professional-level English.Formal education in marketing, communications, journalism, or a related discipline.Travel

International travel, including travel to customer and mine sites may be required.What success looks like

Success will be assessed equally across content and digital campaign management. For content, you will deliver accurate, engaging, audience-focused work that supports agreed business priorities, meets brand standards, and is delivered on time, with performance assessed through relevant engagement and content-use measures. For campaigns, you will deliver against agreed objectives, schedules, and budgets, using engagement, lead generation, conversion, and nurture performance to assess effectiveness and guide ongoing optimisation.

You will move confidently between storytelling and campaign execution: developing a customer story or filming on location, then bringing content into targeted campaigns and using performance insights to improve results. Most importantly, you will connect what we create with how it reaches and engages the right audiences, balancing both responsibilities rather than treating campaigns as an extension of content production.

About Hexagon

Hexagon is the global leader in measurement technologies. We provide the confidence that vital industries rely on to build, navigate, and innovate. From microns to Mars, our solutions ensure productivity, quality, safety, and sustainability in everything from manufacturing and construction to mining and autonomous systems.

Hexagon''s Mining division connects the physical and digital worlds of a mine, helping customers make better-informed decisions across the mining lifecycle. Our technologies support safer operations, improved productivity, and better use of resources from mine planning and operations through to processing.

About My Better Balcony: My Better Balcony is an outdoor furniture company specializing in balcony tables and hanging planters. We started My Better Balcony in 2025 and are currently focused on growing our brand, expanding our customer base, and building a strong presence through social media and digital marketing.


Position Overview — We’re looking for a creative, motivated, and independent marketing student to help grow My Better Balcony's social media presence and overall brand awareness. This position will involve developing content in-person, generating marketing ideas, researching potential opportunities, and helping create strategies to reach new customers.


Because My Better Balcony is a growing company, this position offers the opportunity to take initiative, contribute your own ideas, and have a direct impact on the company's marketing efforts.


Responsibilities may include:




Assisting with the development and management of social media content




Creating and brainstorming content ideas for platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook




Helping plan, film, and edit photo and video content




Researching marketing trends, competitors, and potential customers




Identifying opportunities to increase brand awareness and reach new audiences




Assisting with advertising and promotional campaigns




Providing creative ideas and recommendations for growing the My Better Balcony brand




Qualifications / Preferred Skills: We’re searching for a current ASU marketing student who lives in the Tempe area. Ideally, this person has an understanding of social media marketing and is comfortable working within e-commerce platforms such as the My Better Balcony Shopify, Etsy, Amazon, Ebay, etc.

Creative and comfortable contributing new ideas




Interested in social media, marketing, and brand development




Able to work independently and take initiative




Comfortable communicating with businesses and other organizations




Located in or near the Tempe area

The Digital Marketing Specialist is responsible for managing and improving the performance of Desert Financial Credit Union’s owned digital channels, including the website, email, digital advertising, ATMs, digital signage, online banking, digital applications, and other member-facing digital experiences. This role contributes to the planning and execution of digital creative initiatives, helping ensure a consistent, user-friendly, and engaging experience across all digital touchpoints.


The position blends creative craft with a digital-first, mobile-first, user-centered performance mindset, ensuring every asset and experience is on-brand, intuitive, and optimized for the channel it lives in. This is a hands-on role responsible for both design production and cross-functional collaboration. The Digital Marketing Specialist ensures that monthly creative deliverables are published on schedule. 


This role works within Digital Marketing and maintains a partnership with the Creative Team to ensure alignment with brand standards, creative quality, and design best practices.


What you will do here:


Digital Design and Production


Leverage AI-powered productivity tools to scale creative output, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market across digital deliverables


Read and analyze performance data for creative and provide recommendations for optimization


Design and produce digital assets across owned and paid channels, including but not limited to online banking ads, website pages, email templates, and digital ads


Manage digital advertising on owned channels, including online and mobile banking platforms, digital signage and other systems as needed


Apply UI/UX best practices to design intuitive, user-centered digital experiences that improve usability and conversion


Create responsive, mobile-first prototype/designs in programs like Figma optimized for performance across devices, screen sizes, and email/web rendering environments


Prepare, optimize, and deploy assets, ensuring proper file formats, specs, and quality across platforms


Collaboration and Project Execution


Partner with web developers, lifecycle/marketing automation, designers, content, and channel strategy teams to deliver design assets that are production-ready and technically feasible


Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and incorporate user feedback and usability findings into design iterations


Manage and organize digital design files and assets within the team’s digital asset management and file systems


Design Systems and Brand Consistency


Build and maintain reusable design components, UI/UX patterns, templates, and layouts that support speed to market and brand consistency across digital touchpoints


Ensure all creative adheres to brand standards, legal/compliance requirements, and disclosure guidelines for financial services marketing


Design with accessibility in mind, applying inclusive design principles and supporting accessibility standards across digital deliverables


Testing, Optimization, and Iteration


Support A/B testing and experimentation by developing creative variants, analyzing results, identifying performance trends, and recommending design and experience optimizations based on data and insights


Apply usability testing and user research findings to continuously improve the member experience across digital properties


Stay current on digital design, UI/UX, and accessibility trends, tools, and best practices, bringing fresh ideas to elevate the member experience


Perform other job duties as required. 


What you will need:


Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communication, Business, or another related field preferred.


Equivalent combination of experience and education required.


4+ years of professional design experience, with a focus on digital deliverables (web, email, digital ads) and UI/UX design required.


Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and digital analytics, including analyzing website traffic, user behavior, engagement, conversion paths, and campaign performance required.


Ability to interpret digital performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations for creative, UI/UX, content, and conversion optimization required.


Proficiency with Figma or similar tools required.


Proficiency with Adobe Creative Cloud required.


Portfolio demonstrating strong digital design and UI/UX skills across multiple channels and formats required.


Strong understanding of digital marketing, measurement, and conversion optimization principles, including A/B testing, KPI analysis, campaign performance, and data-informed design optimization required.


Working knowledge of designing for digital environments, including responsive/mobile-first design and email/web constraints required.


Strong understanding of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, and UI/UX principles required.


Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment required.


Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work cross-functionally with marketing, web, and creative teams required.


Experience with prototyping and usability testing tools and methods preferred.


Experience designing within a CMS and/or marketing automation platform (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Optimizely, HubSpot) preferred.


Familiarity with basic HTML/CSS as it relates to email and web design preferred.


Experience with motion graphics and/or animation preferred.


Experience working in a regulated industry (e.g., financial services) preferred.


We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.


For additional information about our organization, careers, and benefits visit: http://www.desertfinancial.com/careers.

marketingcommunicationsmanagerkellyskawa.description:
Position: Marketing & Communications Manager


Position Summary


Marketing & Communications Manager is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing marketing initiatives across multiple motorcycle and powersports dealership locations and brands. This position oversees digital marketing, social media management, content creation, promotional campaigns, brand development, event planning, and advertising strategy.


The primary objective is to increase brand awareness, drive dealership traffic, generate qualified sales and service leads, promote inventory, and strengthen customer engagement through consistent and creative marketing efforts.


Key Responsibilities1. Digital Marketing & Advertising



 Develop, manage, and optimize digital advertising campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Facebook and Instagram), and other digital advertising platforms.
 Create targeted advertising campaigns to promote new and used inventory, manufacturer incentives, dealership promotions, parts, accessories, and service departments.
 Research and implement relevant keywords, search themes, audience targeting, and geographic targeting.
 Monitor advertising performance, budgets, campaign effectiveness, and lead generation.
 Coordinate manufacturer advertising requirements and manage co-op advertising submissions and reimbursement documentation.
 Evaluate advertising performance and identify opportunities to improve return on investment.

2. Social Media Management



 Manage and maintain social media accounts across multiple dealership brands and locations.
 Develop content calendars and maintain consistent posting schedules.
 Create engaging posts, promotional content, short-form videos, reels, stories, and other social media assets.
 Monitor audience engagement, respond to customer interactions, and encourage community participation.
 Maintain consistent brand identity, messaging, and tone across dealership social media platforms.
 Identify opportunities to capitalize on industry trends, seasonal promotions, motorcycle events, and manufacturer announcements.

3. Video Production & Content Creation



 Conceptualize, write, film, and edit promotional videos and social media content.
 Produce motorcycle and powersports product showcases, walkaround videos, feature highlights, promotional advertisements, and dealership personality content.
 Develop creative concepts and scripts that communicate product features, dealership promotions, and brand messaging.
 Capture photography and video content for inventory, events, marketing campaigns, and promotional materials.
 Coordinate content production with dealership personnel, sales staff, manufacturers, and outside vendors.
 Maintain an organized library of digital marketing assets and creative materials.

4. Promotional Campaigns & Inventory Marketing



 Develop promotional strategies to increase visibility and sales opportunities for new and used inventory.
 Identify aging inventory and coordinate targeted marketing campaigns and promotional opportunities.
 Create advertising materials for manufacturer incentives, dealership specials, clearance events, and seasonal promotions.
 Coordinate marketing efforts with sales and management teams to prioritize inventory and dealership objectives.
 Develop brand-specific messaging and promotional strategies for various motorcycle and powersports manufacturers.
 Ensure promotional materials accurately reflect pricing, incentives, eligibility requirements, and expiration dates.

5. Event Planning & Community Engagement



 Conceptualize, organize, promote, and execute dealership events and community activities.
 Coordinate event logistics, promotional materials, vendor relationships, and social media coverage.
 Develop opportunities for customer engagement through motorcycle gatherings, product demonstrations, community events, and dealership promotions.
 Work with manufacturers, local businesses, riding groups, and community organizations to develop collaborative marketing opportunities.
 Capture and distribute event photography and video content to extend event visibility and engagement.

6. Brand Development & Creative Services



 Maintain consistent branding and visual identity across dealership locations and manufacturer brands.
 Create and coordinate promotional graphics, advertisements, flyers, banners, email marketing materials, and other marketing collateral.
 Develop creative concepts and messaging that differentiate individual dealerships within a competitive marketplace.
 Coordinate website content, promotional updates, inventory messaging, and search engine optimization initiatives.
 Work with external marketing agencies, website providers, graphic designers, and other vendors as necessary.

7. Vendor & Manufacturer Coordination



 Serve as a marketing point of contact for manufacturers, advertising partners, and outside marketing vendors.
 Coordinate manufacturer advertising programs, promotional requirements, and co-op funding opportunities.
 Review vendor proposals, advertising recommendations, and marketing service agreements.
 Monitor marketing-related expenses and assist management with evaluating advertising investments.
 Ensure marketing materials comply with manufacturer brand standards and advertising guidelines.

8. Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities



 Monitor and report on digital advertising performance, social media engagement, website activity, and marketing initiatives.
 Maintain advertising documentation and records for manufacturer reimbursement programs.
 Coordinate marketing priorities with dealership management and department personnel.
 Manage multiple projects, deadlines, campaigns, and promotional schedules across dealership locations.
 Research industry developments, emerging marketing opportunities, and competitive advertising strategies.

Qualifications & Skills



 Experience in digital marketing, social media management, advertising, or content creation.
 Proficiency with Google Ads and Meta advertising platforms.
 Experience with video filming, editing, and short-form content production.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Knowledge of social media trends, digital advertising strategies, and audience engagement.
 Graphic design and creative software experience.
 Strong organizational and project management abilities.
 Ability to manage multiple brands, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
 Creative problem-solving skills and the ability to develop independent marketing initiatives.
 Familiarity with motorcycles, powersports products, and the motorcycle industry preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


Performance may be evaluated using the following metrics:



 Digital advertising performance and return on investment.
 Qualified sales and service leads generated through marketing.
 Website traffic and inventory engagement.
 Social media audience growth and engagement.
 Video reach, views, and audience retention.
 Effectiveness of inventory-specific promotional campaigns.
 Event attendance and customer participation.
 Successful execution of manufacturer co-op advertising programs.
 Timely completion of marketing projects and campaigns.

Marketing & Communications Manager is expected to balance creative marketing initiatives with measurable business objectives. The position requires an individual who can independently develop ideas, manage marketing platforms, produce engaging content, coordinate promotional activities, and execute campaigns that contribute to dealership growth and customer engagement.

Excitement about defining what an AI cloud brand looks like for the people building on it.

Writing/editing instincts for developer-facing copy.

About The RoleThe Partner Product Marketing Manager crafts the narrative for G2's partnerships and Buyer Intent product line, translating complex integrations into clear value propositions and sales enablement. Partnering closely with Product, Sales, and Partnerships, this role aligns market insights with product strategy to drive partner adoption and remove usage barriers.

In This Role, You Will: The Partner Product Marketing Manager works closely with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and the Senior Partner Marketing Manager to translate complex technical integrations, data partnerships, and joint offerings into a clear “better together” story. The role helps define why G2 and a partner’s capabilities are more valuable together, the customer problems they solve, and the outcomes they enable.

This role is focused on our partners, along with our Buyer Intent product line. G2’s partnerships, including technology integrations, data relationships, and channel and ecosystem partners, are a growing way to put G2 buyer intent data in front of buyers inside the tools they already use. The Partner Product Marketing Manager owns customer and market insight, positioning, messaging, joint value propositions, and sales and partner enablement for G2’s partner offerings. This role also represents the voice of the customer to Partnerships and Product, helping those teams understand customer needs, adoption barriers, and opportunities.

You will work side by side with the Partnerships team, who own the relationships and deal structure, and with the Growth Marketing Senior Partner Marketer, who owns partnership marketing strategy and activation. You are the strategic and storytelling counterpart to both.

Partner go-to-market Strategy:

Develop and validate positioning, messaging, joint value propositions, and priority customer use cases for each partner offering.

Own messaging strategy and enablement readiness for partner-related feature  launches, and identify the core narrative, proof points, and sales materials required. Partner with the partner marketer on the marketing launch plan and with Product and Partnerships on offering readiness.

Assist Partnerships with prioritization by defining the market case for each partner (audience, differentiation, and expected customer value).

Draft workflow guides, technical docs, and setup resources with Partnership and Product teams, maintaining content ownership while technical leads validate accuracy.

Develop and maintain the core content G2 sellers and partner teams need to understand, position, sell, and promote our joint offerings, including joint value propositions, ‘better together’ narratives, pitch decks, one-pagers, FAQs, and materials.

Create content for partner audiences, such as partner sales teams, solutions engineers, and partner marketing contacts, not just G2’s own.

Keep all partner content consistent with G2’s brand voice and core Buyer Intent positioning.

Work with Sales Enablement to build and deliver internal and partner enablement: pitch guidance, battlecards, objection handling, integration use cases, and customer proof points.

Collaborate with the Senior Partner Marketing Manager, Growth Marketing, and Events to develop content and enablement for partner launches, training sessions, and G2’s presence at partner events.

Define positioning, messaging, customer evidence, and subject-matter content for partner events, making sure it ties back to the partner’s GTM strategy.

Manage Partnerfleet and product messaging across partner pages, marketplace listings, and docs. Set listing standards, assist partners with G2 pages, and keep resources up to date.

Supporting Buyer Intent  and other Partner Launches:

Define the target customer profile, messaging, and positioning for Buyer Intent features and other partner-based features across the full suite to differentiate our offering in the market.

Develop comprehensive GTM launch plans across all customer-facing channels, aligning product messaging with key buyer pain points

Own positioning, messaging, customer use-case validation, and sales and partner enablement for each data-enabled partner offering. Equip the partner marketer to develop the marketing launch and activation plan that best addresses the customer's pain points and market opportunity.

Work with Buyer Intent Product and Partnerships to determine how G2 buyer intent data can power a partner’s platform or workflow, and which use cases create the most customer value.

Translate that data connection into a clear story for the partner’s customers and for G2’s sellers: what the data is, how it shows up in the partner’s product, and what outcome it drives.

Customer, Sales, and Market Insight:

Establish an ongoing feedback loop through customer interviews, sales conversations, win/loss analysis, partner feedback, and competitive research.

Analyze partner adoption data and cross-functional feedback with Product, Partnerships, and CS to identify usage barriers. Use these insights to optimize onboarding, enablement, and joint adoption programs.

Synthesize unmet needs, objections, adoption barriers, and emerging use cases into recommendations for Partnerships and Product. Track how those insights inform offering development, prioritization, positioning, and enablement.

Define success metrics for partner launches and events, such as partner-enabled use-case adoption, enablement usage, partner activation, and message resonance, and report learnings to Partnerships, Product, and Growth Marketing.

 5+ years in product marketing, partner marketing, or a closely related GTM role, ideally in B2B SaaS or data and intent products.

Experience building go-to-market strategies and launching offerings with technology, data, or channel partners.

Strong writing skills, with the ability to create clear, persuasive content for external partner audiences as well as internal teams.

Ability to translate data-driven products into clear customer value.

Proven ability to build sales and partner enablement that gets used.

Excellent cross-functional collaboration with Partnerships, Product, Sales, and Marketing, and comfort working through influence rather than direct authority.

Comfort with CRM, enablement, and analytics tools.

Location: Remote (with periodic travel)


  Employment Type: Full-time, salaried, exempt


  Schedule: 32-hour work week, 4-day full-time position


  Pay Range: $85,000-$90,000/annually


 
 About Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA)
 

  Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to building the capacity of low- and moderate-income communities to achieve and sustain economic self-sufficiency, with a particular focus on Native Hawaiians. Through housing counseling, financial education, lending partnerships, housing initiatives, and innovative programming, HCA works to create long-term pathways toward economic resilience and housing stability across Hawaiʻi. As a Native Hawaiian-focused organization, HCA values adaptability, innovation, cultural grounding, collaboration, and commitment to community. We operate in an evolving environment requiring both mission alignment and the ability to build systems that support organizational growth. 
 

 
Position Summary

 

 The Director of Communications & Marketing is responsible for the planning, execution, coordination, and performance of all marketing and communications activities across Hawaiian Community Assets (HCA). This role is responsible for developing marketing strategy and systems, launching and managing campaigns, generating qualified leads, supporting revenue goals, and translating the CEO’s narrative and organizational priorities into clear, culturally grounded, public-facing communications.


 

   This is not a passive support role. The Director is expected to lead the marketing and communications function as an accountable operating system across HCA’s major organizational pillars: Programs, Ua Hale Aʻela, Real Estate Brokerage, Fund Development, and Awareness/Education campaigns.


   The Director owns marketing strategy, planning, campaign execution, brand consistency, content delivery, and performance tracking within CEO-aligned direction. The role requires proactive planning, cross-team coordination, vendor management, data-informed decision-making, and clear accountability for measurable outcomes.





 Scope of Responsibility: Core Organizational Pillars


 The Director is responsible for ensuring communications and marketing work is actively planned, balanced, and executed across the following pillars. No pillar should be neglected or overprioritized without leadership alignment.





 1. Programs: HUD-Certified Counseling & Financial Education


 
  Drive awareness, trust, and enrollment in HCA’s HUD-certified housing counseling, financial education, and financial capability programs.
  Position financial education and counseling as the backbone of HCA’s housing and economic self-sufficiency model.
  Communicate clear client wins, measurable outcomes, and service pathways so families understand why and how to engage.
  Ensure messaging is culturally grounded, accessible, and prioritized toward Native Hawaiian communities while remaining inclusive of low- and moderate-income households statewide.
 
 2. Ua Hale Aʻela: Real Estate Development, Rent-to-Own, and Available Units


 
  Lead marketing strategy and campaign execution for Ua Hale Aʻela units and program pipeline.
  Generate qualified applicants for each available unit and ensure marketing reaches the right households, not just the largest audience.
  Coordinate with real estate and program teams so marketing launches align with unit readiness, occupancy goals, application timelines, and client qualification requirements.
  Track inquiry volume, qualification rates, lead sources, and cost efficiency for each unit or campaign.
 
 3. Real Estate Brokerage: Mission-Driven Real Estate Services


 
  Build market awareness and trust for HCA’s real estate brokerage as a mission-driven option for buyers, sellers, nonprofit partners, and property management clients.
  Position the brokerage as a way for local residents, mission-aligned sellers, nonprofits, and out-of-state investors to support affordable housing and help Hawaiʻi’s people connect to homes.
  Generate inquiries for buyers, sellers, property management clients, nonprofit partners, and mission-aligned real estate opportunities.
  Support Year 1 brokerage awareness while building the foundation for future transaction and revenue growth.
 
 4. Fund Development: Campaigns, Donor Engagement, and Mission-Aligned Partnerships


 
  Lead the marketing strategy that supports fundraising, donor engagement, campaign visibility, and partner communication.
  Work with the development/fundraising team to create marketing strategies that align with fund development priorities and help deliver campaign goals.
  Contribute measurable revenue or pipeline influence through campaign messaging, donor-facing materials, digital outreach, annual report use, storytelling, and audience engagement.
  Support the $25M campaign and other funding efforts through clear, compelling, and consistent marketing that moves audiences toward action.
 
 5. Awareness, Education & Public Engagement: Cross-Cutting Mission Campaigns


 
  Launch quarterly awareness and education campaigns aligned with HCA’s mission and community needs.
  Use program data, client outcomes, and accessible storytelling to position HCA as a trusted source of education and public awareness.
 
 Role Authority and Alignment


 
  The CEO sets the high-level organizational narrative, vision, and strategic priorities. The Chief Strategy Officer provides executive strategic leadership and oversight for communications and marketing as part of broader organizational strategy, positioning, revenue, and growth priorities. The Senior Director of Strategic Operations, under the direction of the Chief Strategy Officer, provides operational oversight, coordination, and accountability support for communications and marketing systems, workflows, execution, and cross-department alignment.
  The Director is responsible for developing, translating, operationalizing, and delivering marketing and communications strategies aligned to CEO direction, Chief Strategy Officer priorities, and organizational goals.
  The Director may shape external positioning, messaging frameworks, and campaign strategies, but those efforts must remain aligned with CEO direction, executive leadership priorities, and organizational objectives.
  The Director is responsible for building and managing marketing systems, campaign infrastructure, and communications workflows; the CEO, Chief Strategy Officer, and Senior Director of Strategic Operations should not have to build the operating system for the role.
  The Director is accountable for execution and outcomes, not only ideas, recommendations, or completed tasks.
 
 Essential Duties


 
  Marketing Strategy Development and Annual Planning
  Campaign Planning, Management, and Delivery
  Marketing Systems and Operational Infrastructure
  Messaging, Narrative, and Cultural Integrity
  External Positioning and Brand Governance
  Fund Development Marketing Strategy and Revenue Contribution
  Lead Generation, Audience Targeting, and Cost Efficiency
  Ua Hale Aʻela Marketing Execution
  Real Estate Brokerage Marketing and Market Development
  Programs Marketing: HUD Counseling and Financial Education
  Awareness, Education, and Data Storytelling Campaigns
  Content Production and Communications Execution
  Annual Report Development and Delivery
  Media Relations, Public Relations, and Leadership Support
  Asset Utilization and Content Lifecycle Management
  Team Coordination, Cross-Department Accountability, and Vendor Management
  Performance Tracking, Dashboard Management, and Reporting
  Responsiveness, Execution Discipline, and Professional Accountability
 Supervisory Responsibilities
 

  Directly supervises 1 non-supervisory employee (Communications & Marketing Manager), contractors, and/or virtual assistants. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. 
 

 

 

 Education

 This position requires a Bachelor's degree. A Bachelor's degree is preferred.

       Office of Research & Partnerships (ORP) Marketing and Communications team at the University of Arizona is in search of a Marketing Specialist II. managerdigitalmarketingconversationalage.title: Manager, Digital Marketing — Conversational & Agentic AI
managerdigitalmarketingconversationalage.description:
Manager, Digital Marketing — Conversational & Agentic AI 

 The opportunity 

 ADP is looking for a Manager, Digital Marketing — Conversational & Agentic AI to shape how prospective customers discover, evaluate and buy from ADP through AI-powered conversations, demos and emerging digital experiences on ADP.com. You will own the roadmap for these experiences, starting with our AI chatbot and AI SDR demo pilots. Your goal is to help buyers explore the right solutions and take the next step, while improving conversion, lead quality and qualified sales opportunities. 

 This is a marketing strategy and delivery role on the Digital Marketing team. You will apply buyer insight, journey design and experimentation to turn business goals into better digital experiences. As the single product owner, you will work with Digital Marketing leadership and Sales Operations to create and prioritize the roadmap and serve as the single point of contact for roadmap prioritization. You will partner with Global Product Technology (GPT), which owns technical implementation and delivery. You will also help ADP.com prepare for a world in which AI agents participate in research, comparison and purchasing decisions. 

 What you will own 

   Own buyer journey strategy and the roadmap for conversational and agentic experiences on ADP.com. Maintain a transparent, prioritized backlog and issue tracker; define requirements, milestones, dependencies and success measures with partner teams.  Lead the evolution of the AI chatbot experience, including its placement, prompts, content, handoffs and qualification flows. Improve the buyer experience while reducing misrouted client and employee support inquiries.  Drive the AI SDR demo pilot and its next iterations, from the product walkthrough and question handling through lead capture, qualification, personalized nurture and routing to the appropriate sales team.  Identify and test additional experiences across the buyer journey, such as conversational lead or quote forms, appointment scheduling, guided product selection and support for digital purchase where appropriate.  Partner with Sales Operations to define qualification criteria, routing rules, CRM handoffs, seller feedback loops and follow up processes so that promising conversations turn into usable sales opportunities.  Translate marketing and buyer needs into clear briefs and requirements for GPT and other partners. Work with analytics, product, content, privacy and legal teams to coordinate launch readiness, quality assurance, escalation, issue resolution and continuous improvement.  Lead conversion optimization and experimentation using buyer research, funnel analysis and conversation review. Measure engagement, conversation quality, lead capture, lead quality, sales acceptance and downstream opportunities; share clear recommendations with leadership.  Track emerging agentic shopping behaviors and recommend how ADP.com should support them, including trusted product information, discoverable content and potential agent accessible capabilities, in partnership with the teams that own those systems.  #LI-CS5

 #LI-HYBRID

 

What you bring 

   6+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, conversion rate optimization, digital experience, digital product management or marketing technology, with a record of improving buyer journeys and delivering measurable business results.  Experience owning a roadmap and driving work across product, engineering and commercial teams without relying on direct authority; strong judgment on prioritization, scope and tradeoffs.  Hands-on experience with digital lead generation, marketing automation, conversational experiences or self-service buying journeys; curiosity about AI and the ability to evaluate new capabilities with appropriate rigor.  Strong grasp of conversion funnels and experimentation, including how to connect interaction metrics to lead quality, sales outcomes and business impact.  Ability to write clear requirements, map complex journeys, coordinate testing and QA, and turn ambiguous ideas into decisions and shipped improvements.  Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; comfortable working with technical partners, Sales Operations and senior marketing leaders.  Especially valuable 

 Experience with conversational AI, chatbots, AI assistants or AI SDR platforms, including Salesforce Agentforce or Spara, is valuable; prior experience with these specific platforms is not required. Other valuable experience includes B2B SaaS, payroll, HR technology or other considered purchases; CRM and marketing automation integrations; privacy and responsible AI review; and buyer research or usability testing. 

 How success will be measured 

 A prioritized roadmap that moves into production; measurable improvements in relevant buyer engagement and experience quality; more qualified leads and opportunities attributable to conversational journeys; reliable sales handoffs; and evidence based decisions about which emerging experiences ADP should scale. 

 Base salary offers for this position may vary based on factors such as location, skills, and relevant experience. Some positions may include additional compensation in the form of bonus, equity or commissions. We offer the following benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance, Matched Retirement Savings, Wellness Program, Short-and Long-Term Disability, Charitable Contribution Match, Holidays, Personal Days & Vacation, Paid Volunteer Time Off, and more. The compensation for this role is USD $86,600.00 - USD $161,600.00 / Year*

*Actual compensation will not be less than the applicable minimum wage or minimum exempt salary requirement under federal, state and local laws.

 

 A little about ADP: We are a comprehensive global provider of cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions that unite HR, payroll, talent, time, tax and benefits administration and a leader in business outsourcing services, analytics, and compliance expertise. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating a down-to-earth culture that embraces our core values, welcomes ideas, encourages innovation, and values belonging. We've received recognition for our work by many esteemed organizations, learn more at ADP Awards and Recognition.

 Diversity, Equity, Inclusion & Equal Employment Opportunity at ADP: ADP is committed to an inclusive, diverse and equitable workplace, and is further committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic including: race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, protected veteran status or disability. Hiring decisions are based upon ADP’s operating needs, and applicant merit including, but not limited to, qualifications, experience, ability, availability, cooperation, and job performance.

 Ethics at ADP: ADP has a long, proud history of conducting business with the highest ethical standards and full compliance with all applicable laws. We also expect our people to uphold our values with the highest level of integrity and behave in a manner that fosters an honest and respectful workplace. Click https://jobs.adp.com/life-at-adp/ to learn more about ADP’s culture and our full set of values.

Strategic Partnerships Manager: Digital Marketing Agency/Influencer Partners

Category Sales Location Remote - New York - United States; Atlanta, Georgia; Remote - California (Bay Area) - United States; Charlotte, North Carolina; Frisco, Texas; Mountain View, California; Tucson, Arizona Job ID 23690

Share Job Save JobSaved Job

Company Overview

Intuit is the global financial technology platform that powers prosperity for the people and communities we serve. With tens of millions of customers worldwide using products such as TurboTax, Credit Karma, QuickBooks, and Mailchimp, we believe that everyone should have the opportunity to prosper. We never stop working to find new, innovative ways to make that possible.

Job Overview

As Strategic Partnerships Manager: Analyst and Agency Partners, you own Intuit''s commercial relationships with two distinct partner segments that sit at the edges of the mid-market ERP ecosystem: independent ERP analysts, and digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses evaluating ERP solutions.

ERP analysts in the mid-market are not the large research firms - they are independent voices: channel consultants, software selection advisors, and influential commentators who cover mid-market ERP platforms, shape buyer decisions, and maintain active networks of prospects and VARs. They generate a steady flow of referral introductions to buyers who trust their judgment. Building relationships with the right analysts and turning those relationships into a consistent pipeline of qualified warm introductions is the core of this motion.

Digital marketing agencies represent a different but equally valuable opportunity. Many agencies serve mid-market clients who need ERP solutions as part of broader digital transformation work - and those agencies need somewhere to route those leads. This role builds the program and relationships that make Intuit the natural destination for those introductions.

Both motions share the same KPI: qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner. You are not accountable for closed-won revenue - you are accountable for the quality and volume of the pipeline you generate through these relationships.

PRIMARY KPI: Qualified warm introductions attributable to a specific analyst or agency partner - defined as a mid-market prospect introduction where an IES, QuickBooks Advanced, or Intuit Services opportunity has been identified. Measured separately for analyst and agency segments.

Responsibilities

ERP analyst relationships

Identify and map the independent ERP analyst community relevant to Intuit''s mid-market segment: channel consultants, software selection advisors, VAR-channel commentators, and influential voices whose audiences include mid-market ERP buyers and channel partners.Build and maintain active relationships with target analysts, positioning Intuit Enterprise Suite and QuickBooks Advanced as platforms worth recommending - keeping analysts current on product direction, competitive positioning, and the partner program.Drive a consistent cadence of introductions from analyst relationships: warm referrals from analysts to mid-market prospects actively evaluating or replacing ERP platforms.Provide analysts with the product knowledge, competitive context, and reference materials they need to credibly recommend Intuit''s mid-market platform to their audiences and clients.Track analyst-sourced introductions through the attribution model, ensuring each qualified referral is tagged to the originating analyst and reflected in pipeline reporting.Digital marketing agency relationships

Identify and recruit digital marketing agencies whose client base includes mid-market businesses with ERP needs - prioritizing agencies with active practices in verticals where IES has strong product-market fit.Build the agency partner engagement model: define the value proposition for agency partners, develop the referral process and attribution mechanism, and create the co-marketing and lead-routing infrastructure that makes it easy for agencies to send leads to Intuit.Enable agency partners on Intuit''s mid-market product lineup and lead qualification criteria - ensuring that introductions from agencies meet the quality threshold for IES sales engagement.Drive ongoing engagement with active agency partners: regular pipeline reviews, co-marketing activity, and program performance conversations.Track agency-sourced introductions through the same attribution model as the analyst segment.Portfolio management & reporting

Maintain an active and prioritized portfolio of analyst and agency partners, with clear visibility into relationship health, referral activity, and pipeline contribution per partner.Identify underperforming relationships and develop targeted activation plans - additional enablement, co-marketing investment, or relationship reset as appropriate.Report regularly on analyst and agency pipeline contribution to Felicia Wilson and the broader Commercial Partnerships leadership.Surface market intelligence from analyst and agency conversations - buyer sentiment, competitive dynamics, and segment trends - to the IES product and go-to-market teams.Cross-functional collaboration

Collaborate with the ISV Partner Manager and other Commercial BD colleagues to identify where analyst or agency relationships intersect with or amplify other partner motions.Work with marketing to develop analyst-specific content programs, agency co-marketing campaigns, and thought leadership materials that strengthen Intuit''s position in the mid-market ERP ecosystem.Engage with the IES product team to keep analyst partners current on roadmap direction and ensure that Intuit''s product story is compelling and accurate in analyst-generated content and recommendations.Qualifications

Required

10+ years of experience in channel partnerships, business development, or partner management within a SaaS or enterprise software company.Familiarity with the mid-market ERP analyst and channel consultant community - you know who the influential voices are, how they operate, and what motivates them to refer business.Demonstrated experience building commercial partner relationships and driving referral pipeline through those relationships.Strong communication and relationship-building skills: able to engage credibly with independent analysts and digital agency principals, and to maintain productive long-term relationships with minimal formal program infrastructure.Experience managing a partner portfolio with clear pipeline tracking and attribution discipline.Proficiency with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and standard sales and partnership productivity platforms.Preferred

Direct experience working with mid-market ERP channel analysts, software selection consultants, or VAR-channel commentators - you have existing relationships in this community.Experience building agency partner programs, including referral process design, lead qualification frameworks, and co-marketing infrastructure.Familiarity with Intuit Enterprise Suite, QuickBooks Advanced, or competing mid-market ERP platforms (Sage Intacct, Acumatica, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics).Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The expected base pay range for this position is:

California Remote (Bay Area) $186,500- $252,500

Mountain View, CA $186,500- $252,500
